articleTitle: Application of TOPSIS Algorithm in Tax Online Filing System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The role of online declaration in effectively improving the service quality of tax authorities is very important, but there is a mismatch in the search business scope. Web browsing technology cannot solve the problem of online filing in tax collection work, and the tax assessment is not reasonable. Therefore, this paper proposes a TOPSIS algorithm for declaration evaluation and analysis. Online tax filing has become a trend, but there are many problems that need to be optimized in the process. The TOPSIS algorithm is introduced into the optimization of online tax returns, aiming at providing a new decision-making tool for decision makers to improve the efficiency and accuracy of online tax returns.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Performance of CsSnCl3-Based Perovskite Solar Cells Through SCAPS Simulation Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Recently, there has been a lot of interest in the development and manufacturing of lead-free perovskite compounds for the fabrication of PSCs. A promising and effective absorption material for free-of-lead PSC is CsSnCl3 (Cesium tin chloride). This research paper focuses on investigating the effect of the thickness of CsSnCl3 layer on the PV (photovoltaic) parameters using the SCAPS tool. Perovskite solar cells (PSCs) are an obtainable device for creating renewable energy because of their greater efficiency and low manufacturing costs. The effect of thickness variance on device efficacy has been investigated. The suggested ITO/TiO2/CsSnCl3/Cu2O/Au device structure is developed. The thickness of the CsSnCl3 absorber in this suggested study ranges from 50 to 500 nm, with a bandgap of 1.52 eV. After altering the layer's thickness of the absorbing layer, the following PV measurements are displayed: PCE of 21.33%, VOC of 1.14 V, JSC of 24.58 mA/cm2, and FF of 85.75%.

articleTitle: Alzheimer Disease Detection Using Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a neurodegenerative condition that for the most part influences the cerebrum and causes cognitive decline and continuous mental weakening. This condition weakens the mental state of the patients and slowly kills the reasoning of the brain. It mostly affects the people above the age of 65 that are the senior citizens. The disease can be categorized in four categories that are mild demented, very mild demented, non demented and moderately demented. There is no such accurate treatment for the same, the disease can be genetic and can be based on few hypothesis discussed in this article. But for detecting Alzheimer, the most common method is the MRI scans which are used as a dataset in form of scanned image in this research work. For easing the work of the doctors the use of technique like deep learning is used which is widely known for image and speech recognition. CNN the commonly used deep learning algorithm is used to create the proposed model and the dataset is collected from Kaggle. The model gives accurate results for detecting the disease and its categories and the accuracy attained after rigorous testing is 98%. This model when combined with the present detecting techniques can do wonders in detecting the disease in early stage and help the doctors provide accurate treatment for the same.

articleTitle: Research on Bioengineering Algorithm based on Dynamic Fuzzy Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Dynamic Fuzzy Neural Network (DFNN) is an extension of Fuzzy Neural Network (FNN). It combines the advantages of fuzzy logic and neural network to deal with uncertainty and fuzziness.In recent years, with the rapid development of bioengineering, the application of dynamic fuzzy neural network in the field of bioengineering has been paid more and more attention. This paper will focus on the impact and prospect of dynamic fuzzy neural network on bioengineering.

articleTitle: Assessing the Validity of Automated Data Analysis Methods Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Automated records analysis strategies primarily based on artificial intelligence (AI) have become increasingly famous in recent years because of their capability to quickly and effectively method enormous quantities of facts. However, concerns about the validity of those methods and their potential for introducing bias or mistakes have been raised. This study aims to assess the validity of automatic facts evaluation methods based on AI. It entails evaluating those methods' accuracy, reliability, and consistency compared to conventional guide evaluation methods. An expansion of study methods may be used, which includes experimental research, case research, and surveys. Facts will be gathered from computerized AI techniques and manual strategies, after which they will be compared and evaluated to decide the extent of agreement between them. One capability mission in this research is the dearth of a gold standard for statistics analysis. Unlike in medical fields wherein there may be a clean popular for prognosis, information analysis methods can also vary depending on the unique dataset and research question. Expanding a hard and fast of criteria or metrics for evaluating the validity of different AI techniques is essential. Another challenge is the rapidly evolving nature of the AI era. As new techniques and algorithms constantly evolve, keeping up with modern-day improvements and their potential impact on records analysis could be challenging.

articleTitle: SMA Pavement Anti-Slip Performance Prediction Model Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Genetic algorithm (GA) is an optimization algorithm based on the theory of biological evolution, which can be used to solve complex optimization problems. For SMA pavement, genetic algorithm can improve its daily skid resistance by optimizing material ratio and other parameters. At the same time, in the aspect of risk prediction, genetic algorithm can also be used to analyze the wear status of SMA pavement and predict potential risks. Effect and influence of genetic algorithm on daily skid resistance of SMA pavement. SMA pavement is a kind of pavement with high strength and durability, but its skid resistance is one of the key factors. In order to improve the daily skid resistance of SMA pavement, it is necessary to choose appropriate materials and proportions. However, because there are many kinds of materials and distributions of SMA pavement, a large number of tests and tests are needed to get the best scheme.

articleTitle: Characterizing Radio Frequency Transmission and Attenuation in Underwater Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Underwater EM-RF communication poses a significant challenge due to the distinctive properties of seawater. These properties include Propagation speed, Attenuation, Frequency-Dependence Absorption, Conductivity, Dielectric constant etc. The seawater is saline in nature and because of its salinity, it exhibits these properties leading to the absorption of the EM waves, especially RF waves. RF waves are rapidly attenuated in seawater due to conductivity, permeability, and permittivity, understanding these characteristics of electromagnetic wave propagation in seawater is crucial. The frequency variation of seawater's permittivity controls these characteristics. Our model shows the Extremely Low Frequency band can travel long distance in seawater with low attenuation but it requires large antennas and high power to transmit these ELF bands. Temperature, frequency and salinity changes with depth in the presence of EM wave. This demonstrates a drastic decrease in the attenuation of RF wave in deep water compared to shallow water, particularly for high Frequency up to 1THz. The calculations made in this paper is mainly dominated by Debye Polar Molecules.

articleTitle: Apple Variety Classification: Leveraging CNN and Random Forest for Precision
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: An important difficulty in computer vision and agricultural technology is the automatic classification of apple cultivars based on their shape, texture, and colour properties. In this article, we suggest a unique method for tackling this problem that combines Random Forest classifiers and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). In total, 5,510 high-resolution photos of the five well-known apple cultivars Gala, Cortland, Pink Lady, Honeycrisp, and Fuji were gathered in our extensive collection. In the first step of our process, a CNN automatically extracts distinguishing features from these photos. Four convolutional layers with ReLU activation make up the CNN architecture, which is followed by layers with maximum pooling to reduce spatial dimension. The Random Forest classifier then uses the output probabilities from the CNN to determine the final classification. We rigorously experimented to show the accuracy and resilience of our model in identifying these apple types. Deep learning and ensemble approaches work together to successfully capture minute variations in shape, texture, and colour. The agriculture and food industries stand to benefit significantly from this research in terms of automated quality control, precise inventory management, and increased customer satisfaction. Our method opens up new directions for future study in automated fruit classification and agricultural automation while demonstrating the potential of contemporary machine learning techniques to simplify difficult agricultural operations.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Music Annotation Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With the advent of the digital age, a large number of music works exist in digital form, which makes music automatic tagging an important research field. Automatic music tagging refers to the use of computer technology to classify, label and describe music in order to better organize and retrieve music resources. As an important technology in the field of artificial intelligence, deep learning has a profound impact on automatic music tagging. This paper will discuss in detail the influence, methods and measures of deep learning on automatic music tagging.

articleTitle: Chronic Kidney Disease (Ckd) Prediction by Supervised Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The function of kidney is filtering waste and excess fluid from our body which is then let out through urine excretion. Due to Chronic Kidney disease there will be kidney impairment. This may also lead to several complications like anaemia, high blood pressure, anorexia, and mental and physical health issues. In India, there was a 38% increase in the number of people who succumbed to kidney failure between 2001–03 and 2010–2013 which sums up to about 10 crore cases in the previous year. Thus, the prediction of this disease before end-stage renal failure is much needed. This model uses binary text classification and machine learning algorithms. We have assessed the performance of different models on CKD and the following are the results: Naive Bayes Classification as accuracy of 95.83%, XGBoost Classification as an accuracy of 100%, Logistic Regression achieved an accuracy of 99.16%, SVM Classification as an accuracy of 98.3%, Random Forest Classification as an accuracy of 100%, Artificial Neural Network (ANN) as an accuracy of 98.33%, K-Nearest Neighbors Classification (KNN) achieved an accuracy of 96.67%, Gradient Boost Classification as an accuracy of 100%, AdaBoost Classification as an accuracy of 100%, and Decision Tree Classification as an accuracy of 99.16%.

articleTitle: Early Skin Cancer Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Skin cancer is a prevalent and potentially life-threatening disease which is increasing day by day globally, due to the depletion of the ozone layer and other atmosphere changes. Various computer-aided methods have been proposed for diagnosis of skin cancer. However, for accurate diagnosis of skin cancer, computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) system poses several difficulties. These includes data quality, heterogeneity and complexity of skin layers which is a challenging visual characteristic for cell detection. Challenge of automatically and effectively extracting discriminative features for skin cancer detection is indeed a significant research problem in the field of medical image analysis. Deep learning-based methods have shown great promise in automating feature extraction by learning relevant features directly from the raw images. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and other deep architectures can automatically discover hierarchical features that may not be apparent to human experts. However, these models require a large amount of labeled data for training, which can be a challenge for the skin cancer detection. To address these challenges and further improve deep learning models for skin cancer detection. The architecture of Alex Net offers an innovative approach by proposing a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based Alex net model. This technique involves pre-trained weights and features learned by Alex net model on large datasets. Additionally for accurate skin cancer diagnosis, data augmentation techniques are employed to enhance the robustness and generalization capabilities of the model. The proposed model achieves 98.0% accuracy with augmentation and without any augmentation it achieves 92.9% accuracy.

articleTitle: Image Recognition Method of HOG Algorithm Based on Grid Cell Memory
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Nowadays, computer technology is developing rapidly, and image recognition technology makes a very important part of it used in many places, such as surveillance, face recognition, image matching, etc. Image recognition technology can solve some problems in people's lives and scientific research. Traditional image recognition methods cannot be more accurate image recognition. the HOG algorithm is used to analyze and identify the images, and the indicators are divided according to the image forms an image recognition scheme, and comprehensively analyzes the image recognition results. the HOG algorithm based on grid cell memory are better than those of traditional image recognition methods.

Author Keywords: HOG algorithm based on grid cell memory

articleTitle: Designing, Deploying, and Testing a Chaincode for Educational Credentials Verification in a Hyperledger-Operated Blockchain Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The attractiveness of distributed ledger technology as a platform for the implementation of digitalized inter-organizational business processes stems from its inherent ability to handle the lack of trust and transparency between organizations. A blockchain is a classification of distributed ledgers that contains blocks, involving list of data connected by cryptography. Every block has a timestamp, a cryptographic hash of the previous block, and a few transaction details. It is commonly used for financial transactions in the case of Bitcoin and Ethereum, popularly known as cryptocurrencies. However, other than this use-case, implementing it in traditional information systems is explored in this paper. The study used Hyperledger Fabric (HLF) to create a permissioned network that supports a distributed ledger, smart contracts (chaincode) and various participants who invoke the transactions on the ledger. Several functions is embedded in the chaincode design as deemed necessary in the analysis of educational verification process of higher educational institutions (HEI). For this scenario, blockchain was believed to be appropriate to address trust, security, privacy, and transparency concerns because this technology prevents data or transactions from being altered once they are saved in a blockchain database. Since it creates an irreversible record, it practically becomes impossible to alter. Any changes to the database provide consistency and completeness by requiring new data blocks to be added to the current chain of blocks in chronological sequence. The blockchain network was interacted upon through Application Programming Interfaces (API). The performance assessment confirmed that the chaincode is working and the functions work as expected. Numerous readings of the response time and the payload size were recorded and kept as results for the endpoint testing of the chaincode. It can be assumed that using blockchain to improve the drawbacks of centralized and/or traditional information systems is viable.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Control Method of Electric Power Emergency Command System based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Electricity is an important energy resource for people's daily production and life, and the distribution network cannot transmit power to people after failure, causing serious economic losses to individuals and society. Therefore, in order to reduce the economic losses caused by grid failures, it is necessary to take isolation fault isolation and power protection measures. Among them, the power emergency command system is an important measure to repair power faults, the system can automatically check power faults in practical application, analyze the types of faults and formulate corresponding emergency plans, command relay protection devices to complete power isolation, better control the scope of power faults, and reduce economic losses. In this paper, the automatic control mode of power emergency command system is studied based on genetic algorithm, which shortens the time of locating power faults in the early stage, accurately locates the fault areas, and generates an emergency treatment plan with high accuracy. Through genetic algorithms, the accuracy and timeliness of grid positioning can be significantly improved, and the requirements of automatic control can be met.

articleTitle: Research on Intrusion Detection Method Based on Machine Learning Algorithm and Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With the popularization and application of Internet technology, people are easy to steal valuable information by cyber attackers in the process of using computer networks and electronic products. In order to maintain a good network environment and protect people's interests, network security issues need to be solved. The role of intrusion detection technology in big data platform and feature selection is particularly important, but there is a problem of inaccurate result evaluation. With the rapid development of network technology, the problem of network security has become increasingly prominent. As an important part of network security, intrusion detection plays an important role in preventing network attacks and maintaining system stability. In recent years, the application of machine learning algorithm and big data technology in the field of network intrusion detection has gradually attracted wide attention. This paper mainly discusses the role of these technologies in the process of intrusion detection and its impact on detection results.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Approach to Road Sign Detection and Recognition for Autonomous Driving Systems and Road Safety
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This study provides a comprehensive system designed to perform critical functions such as detecting and recognizing traffic signs. These tasks are critical in modern transportation systems, improving road safety and enabling autonomous driving. To achieve its goals, the system uses multiple technologies such as image processing, natural language processing, transfer learning, and deep learning. The system is made up of several components, including image acquisition, pre-processing, sign detection, classification, text detection, translation, comparison, and audio generation. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and other object detection models, such as YOLO, are investigated for their use in identifying traffic signs, demonstrating their effectiveness under a variety of conditions. Real-time functionality is a key feature, making the system applicable to autonomous driving scenarios. Moreover, it accommodates different languages, enhancing user accessibility. The study addresses the important issue of detecting and recognizing traffic signs, with consequences for traffic management and road safety.

articleTitle: Research on Junction Temperature Control of LED Lamps for New Energy Vehicles based on Time-Delay PID Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Nowadays, energy consumption is becoming more and more serious, and some energy is a non-renewable resource, resulting in a decrease in energy quantity. Therefore, new energy sources are needed to replace and reduce the use of non-renewable resources. Among them, cars consume too many non-renewable resources, in order to solve this problem, new energy vehicles were born. In new energy vehicles, LED lamp junction temperature control is very important, the lower the junction temperature, the better, can extend the service life, so the junction temperature needs to be controlled. Traditional control methods cannot accurately solve the problem of LED lamp junction temperature control in new energy vehicles. Therefore, a time-delay PID algorithm is proposed to analyze the junction temperature control of LED lamps. First of all, artificial intelligence is used to control the junction temperature of the LED lamp, and the index is divided according to the requirements of the junction temperature control of the LED lamp to reduce the interference factors in the junction temperature control of the LED lamp. Then, artificial intelligence controls the junction temperature of LED lamps of new energy vehicles, forms an LED lamp junction temperature control scheme, and comprehensively analyzes the results of LED lamp junction temperature control. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy of LED lamp junction temperature control and the reliability of LED lamp junction temperature control of new energy vehicles by the time-delay PID algorithm are better than those of traditional control methods.

articleTitle: The Improved Bacterial Foraging Algorithm Solves the Spectrum Allocation Problem of Cognitive Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The limited nature of spectrum resources has become one of the bottlenecks restricting the development of wireless communication. Cognitive wireless network is a new type of wireless communication network that uses cognitive technology to improve spectrum utilization, thereby alleviating the shortage of spectrum resources. However, the spectrum allocation problem of cognitive wireless networks is a complex optimization problem, and traditional optimization algorithms have certain limitations in solving this problem. Therefore, an improved bacterial foraging algorithm is proposed for innovative spectrum utilization evaluation and analysis. Firstly, cognitive theory is indicators are reduce interference factors in spectrum utilization evaluation. Then, cognitive theory evaluates the spectrum utilization of cognitive wireless networks, forms a spectrum utilization evaluation scheme. The experimental results show that the improved bacterial foraging algorithm has good performance and effect in solving the spectrum allocation problem of cognitive wireless network under certain evaluation criteria.

articleTitle: Application of LSTM and Ant Colony Algorithms in Intelligent Power Plant Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Power dispatching is a very effective management method in the management of safe and stable operation of power grid and external power supply, but too much historical power generation data and information is not processed, resulting in ineffective utilization. Manual methods cannot solve the large amount of information feedback from the device. Therefore, an intelligent dispatching algorithm based on LSTM and ant colony algorithm is proposed for power dispatching analysis. First of all, the computer is used to sort out and analyze the power data information, and the indicators are divided according to the power dispatching requirements to reduce power dispatching in the interfering factor. Then, the computer optimizes the power dispatch of the power system to form a power dispatching scheme and dispatch the power The results were comprehensively analyzed. MATLAB simulation shows that the intelligent dispatching algorithm based on LSTM and ant colony algorithm is feasible for power dispatching under certain evaluation criteria The efficiency of power dispatching is better than that of manual methods.

Author Keywords: Intelligent scheduling algorithm based on LSTM and ant colony algorithm

articleTitle: Research on Acoustic Environment Design of Residential Communities based on genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With the process of urbanization, the scale of residential quarters is getting bigger and bigger, and the population density is getting higher and higher. Therefore, how to improve the quality of life and comfort in residential quarters has become an important issue. Among them, noise pollution is one of the main factors affecting the quality of life of residents in residential quarters. Traditional acoustic environment optimization methods often need a lot of manpower and material resources, and the effect is not ideal. In this paper, an optimization method of sound environment in residential quarters based on genetic algorithm is proposed. By optimizing the distribution of sound sources in residential quarters, the purpose of reducing noise pollution is achieved

articleTitle: Application of Improved Support Vector Machine Classification Algorithm in Korean Grammar Error Recognition Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In today's rapid development of high technology, the use of scientific and technological means to make the development of Korean grammar better has made a trend, in order to more adapt to the current development, create intelligent Korean grammar, so that the level of Korean grammar specialization is improved, Korean grammar followed. In Korean grammar, it is very important to collect, analyze, and process the information of the living organism in Korean grammar to achieve the specialization of Korean grammar. Dynamic algorithms cannot accurately collect and analyze information problems in Korean grammar. Therefore, an improved support vector machine classification algorithm is proposed for error identification model analysis. Firstly, computer technology is used to collect Internet information, and the indicators are divided according to the requirements of the error identification model to reduce the interference factors in the error identification model. Then, computer technology forms an error recognition model scheme based on the results of Korean grammar error recognition model, and comprehensively analyzes the error recognition model results. ADAMS simulation shows that the improved support vector machine classification algorithm is better than the dynamic algorithm for the accuracy of the error recognition model and the reliability of the error recognition model of Korean grammar under certain evaluation criteria.

Author Keywords: Improved support vector machine classification algorithm

articleTitle: Linear Position Control for the Autofocus of Cameras Using Wavelet Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Automated focus adjustment is a critical aspect of modern camera systems, enabling the capture of sharp and clear images. This paper's novel approach is to automate focus adjustment using wavelet decomposition. The image is decomposed into different frequency subbands using wavelet transform. By computing a focus measure using each subband which quantifies the sharpness or clarity of the image at that particular time, the optimal focus position is found. The algorithm effectively searches for the position that maximises the overall image sharpness and gives the accurate focused image. A web Camera, linear actuator and Arduino UNO microcontroller is used in the project.

articleTitle: Research on Particle Filter in Submarine Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In view of the complex and changeable underwater environment submarine faces, and the noise it receives may not be Gaussian noise. In this paper, particle filter (PF) for nonlinear and non-Gaussian systems is studied. But the biggest problem we face when using PF is particle degradation. In order to solve the influence of particle degradation problem on the tracking and positioning accuracy of submarine targets on enemy ships, improved particle filtering algorithms, namely extended Kalman particle filtering algorithm (EPF) and untraced Kalman particle filtering algorithm (UPF), are also studied in this paper. Under the same initial conditions, the three filtering algorithms are simulated. The simulation results show that UPF algorithm has the best filtering effect in submarine tracking and positioning of enemy ship targets.

Author Keywords: Enemy ship target tracking and positioning

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Mesothelioma: Early Detection and Treatment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Mesothelioma is an extremely severe cancer that can easily transform into lung cancer. Mesothelioma diagnosis takes several months and treatment, including surgery, is expensive. Given the risk, early detection of Mesothelioma is essential for patient health, as it is connected to asbestos exposure. Various machine learning algorithms has been used in this research paper to compare with accurate results for mesothelioma detection. Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), Decision Tree (DT), k Nearest Neighbourhood (k-NN), and Linear Regression (LR) are some of the machine learning methods being used. For this research paper, dataset is available on UCI, called the University of California Irvine [1]. The test dataset contains 264 instances, 35 characteristics and 8 performance measures, which is used to evaluate the classifiers accuracy. The average accuracy of XGB, RF, DT, SGD, LR and Voting Classifier are 100% each. Combing all the classifiers, helps us to break through the Mesothelioma data and the creation of data driven insights to improve patient care.

articleTitle: Design of Dynamic Latched Comparator Using the Offset Calibration Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This paper presents a dynamic latched type comparator with a positive feedback and uses wide usage of offset calibration technique for attaining the minimal offset voltage along with high speed. This is designed by using 45nm CMOS technology with offset voltage and PVT parameters verified. In order to reduce noise, delay and obtain the minimal offset voltage, this design uses extra capacitors by using a method known as digital offset calibration and obtain a value of 10.44mV at a frequency of 33MHZ at a supply voltage of 1.1V. The results are also verified with SS, SF, FS, FF process corners. It has been observed that low power consumption is obtained at SS.

articleTitle: Asphalt Pavement Performance Prediction Based on K-Nearest Neighbor Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Today's social development is inseparable from road engineering, paving roads and building roads makes economic development an important link, which can make economic exchanges more convenient and convenient transportation. Among them, asphalt pavement is often used, and the performance of asphalt pavement structure greatly affects whether the road project can be successfully completed. Therefore, the role of asphalt pavement performance prediction in road engineering is very important. Ordinary performance prediction methods can no longer solve the problem of asphalt pavement performance in road engineering. Therefore, a K-nearest neighbor algorithm is proposed to analyze the performance of asphalt pavement. Firstly, data mining is used to predict and in the performance of asphalt pavement. Then, the data mining predicts the asphalt pavement performance of road engineering, forms the asphalt pavement performance scheme, and comprehensively analyzes the asphalt pavement performance results. the reliability of asphalt pavement performance prediction of K-nearest algorithm for road engineering are better than that of ordinary prediction performance methods.

articleTitle: Enhancing Crop Yield Prediction in India: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Farming is very important for India's economy. Lots of people in India depend on farming to make a living. But farming has become harder because the weather, climate, and environment keep changing. These changes make it tough to grow crops well. We proposed a mechanism called crop yield prediction. It helps us predict how much crops will grow and helps farmers decide what to plant. We use things like where the farm is, how much rain it gets, how hot or cold it is, and what kind of soil is there to make these predictions. These things help us figure out how much crop we can expect. In this proposal we tried out some ma-chine learning models like the Gradient Boosting Regressor, Random Forest Regressor, Support Vector Regressor, and Decision Tree Regressor. We wanted to see which one is the best at predicting crop yields. It turns out the Decision Tree Regressor did the best job and was really accurate with the da-ta we had. This method helps farmers because it means we can use this model to make better predictions about how much food we can grow, which helps the farming community in India grow more food in a good way.

articleTitle: The Detection of Fast Moving Object Using Convolutional Neural Network of Optimized PSO Region
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: An optimized deep learning method for identifying moving objects in video is proposed in this proposed work. When compared to existing algorithms, the proposed algorithm improved detection rate and used less computational time for detection. This is accomplished through the use of extracted features and tuned hyper-parameters in a regional CNN. In general, the regional CNN outperforms the traditional deep learning approach in object detection; however, tuned hyper - parameters using the Cauchy PSO improved its performance. This study employs a regional-based convolutional neural network to recognise objects in video streams, reaching 94% accuracy in all three categories while reducing computational time by 100s for medium and slow moving items and 50s for fast moving objects. When compared to conventional CNN techniques, the optimized RCNN achieves greater than 90% accuracy and takes less time to execute. This demonstrates that the proposed algorithm can be used in surveillance applications to detect abnormal movements.

articleTitle: A Novel Optimization Strategies for Detecting and Preventing Distributed Denial of Service Attacks in Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: allotted Denial of carrier (DDoS) assaults have end up a prime difficulty in trendy wireless networks. these assaults aim to disrupt the regular operation of networks by means of overwhelming them with excessive traffic from more than one assets. traditional DDoS detection and prevention strategies have established to be useless in wireless networks due to the dynamic and unpredictable nature of the wireless surroundings. To deal with this problem, novel optimization techniques were proposed to enhance the potential of wireless networks to discover and prevent DDoS attacks.one of the key techniques is the use of wise algorithms which includes machine learning and synthetic intelligence. these algorithms can analyze and study from network site visitors patterns to pick out strange behavior this is indicative of a DDoS attack. by way of continuously tracking the network and adapting to converting traffic patterns, these algorithms are capable of as it should be locate and mitigate DDoS assaults in actual-time. any other method is the deployment of robust and dynamic defense mechanisms. those mechanisms include the usage of anomaly detection, traffic filtering, and traffic shaping. Anomaly detection strategies rent statistical techniques to hit upon patterns that deviate from ordinary network conduct. traffic filtering involves figuring out and blockading malicious site visitors, even as site visitors shaping manages and controls the flow of legitimate visitors to prevent congestion and enhance community overall performance.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Performance of Machine Learning Algorithms for Real-Time Data Analysis Under Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In current years, studies has shifted away from conventional statistical methods to include more sophisticated gadget studying algorithms including support vector machines, random forests, and deep getting to know for real-time statistics analysis. But, such algorithms have their very own precise challenges, particularly associated with optimization and performance. This studies paper seeks to discover the challenges posed by applying gadget studying algorithms to actual-time datasets and talk the tactics and strategies to optimize the algorithms for stepped forward performance. Using numerous optimization strategies inclusive of evolutionary algorithms, simulated annealing, and evolutionary techniques are introduced to beautify the performance of the machine mastering algorithms. Additionally, the usage of go-validation, hyper parameter tuning, and ensemble methods to enhance the accuracy and pace of the algorithms is investigated. This paper additionally presents an in depth evaluation of the results received from exceptional optimization strategies with regards to overall performance. In the end, potential areas for in addition studies are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Analysis of Formant Transition Cue of the Stop Endings in Wuming Mandarin Based on Linear Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: At present, there remain few studies on locus and co-articulation of the formant transition cue of stop endings in Chinese dialects. In order to fill the gap, the linear regression model is applied to build up locus equation from the F2 terminal value and the target value of the stop endings in Wuming Mandarin to analyze locus and co-articulation of the stop endingss. The research results show that the locus calculated by the locus equation can effectively distinguish bilabial stop endings from dental alveolar stop endings. The research results also demonstrate that the locus of velar stop endings varies with the preceding vowels. The co-articulation effect of the bilabial stop endings is the weakest, while the velar stop ending the strongest, and the dental alveolar stop endings is moderate. In general, the locus and co-articulation of stop endings and stop initials are generally the same.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Digital Banking: Harnessing Blockchain Smart Contracts for Enhanced Security and Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Blockchain technology stands out for its cryptographic connections between chronologically ordered records, forming the core of integrity within the expansive blockchain ecosystem. Leading the charge in this blockchain revolution are digital currencies, reshaping the financial landscape with seamless peer-to-peer transactions. As trailblazers in the realm of blockchain, digital currencies have catalyzed a shift towards decentralized, trust-based financial systems, fundamentally reimagining the global financial stage. This research embarks on an exploration at the intersection of Google Trends analytics and blockchain-based smart contracts. Its objective is to transform and fortify financial transactions within the digital banking sector. Moreover, the study offers a third-person perspective, unveiling valuable insights and recommendations for key stakeholders, such as financial institutions, regulators, and policymakers. These policy directives aim to promote greater financial inclusion, bolster security measures, and cultivate trust within the digital banking realm.

articleTitle: Evaluating 6G Network Technology Principles and Applications: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: As mobile communication networks continue to evolve rapidly, the fifth-generation (5G) technology is already transforming industries and societies worldwide. However, as data demands soar and new applications emerge, the need for even more advanced and efficient wireless networks becomes evident. This review paper presents an in-depth exploration of the emerging sixth-generation (6G) network technology, which is anticipated to revolutionize the way we interact with the digital world. By reviewing the current state of 6G research, this paper aims to offer valuable insights for researchers, practitioners, policymakers, and industry stakeholders, fostering a deeper understanding of the technology's capabilities and challenges and paving the way for the successful deployment of 6G networks in the near future.

articleTitle: College Student Mental Health Early Warning Platform Based on Keyword Matching Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With the development of society and the progress of science and technology, the mental health of college students has been paid more and more attention. How to accurately assess the mental health status of college students, timely warning and take effective intervention measures has become an important issue facing universities and education departmentsAs a text-based data analysis method, keyword matching algorithm provides a new way of thinking for the evaluation, early warning and analysis of college students' mental health. This paper will discuss in detail the application of keyword matching algorithm in the evaluation, early warning and analysis of college students' mental health.

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy Influence Map Evaluation Algorithm in Supply Chain Financial Credit Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)

Phishing assaults often start via the use of electronic mail and include a range of potential aims. The cybercriminal will use social engineering tactics to deceive the victim into clicking on the link included inside the phishing email, so redirecting them to the compromised website. The complexity of these attacks increases as hackers include a human element into their fraudulent activities, therefore creating communications that possess a real appearance. Phishing faces billions of dollars in annual expenditures for Internet users. Identity thieves employ seductive methods to sift through a pool of trusting Internet users in search of personal information. Phishing software and phony emails are used by scammers to get personal information, including passwords and other bank account details. There are three types of tuning elements used: feature selection, hyperparameter optimization, and data balancing. The experiment utilizes two separate datasets acquired from online sources, namely the UCI repository and the Mendeley repository, with the inclusion of the eight most often used machine learning algorithms. The proposed research aims to block phishing attacks and improve accuracy using feature extraction and the CatBoost algorithm. The results will be shown, and the tuning parameters will be shown to increase the effectiveness of machine learning methods.

articleTitle: The Deep Reinforcement Learning for UAV Trajectory Planning in WSNs to Reduce Power Consumption
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have recently been proposed as a solution to the data collection requirements of ubiquitous WSNs. In this study, we investigate a WSN that makes use of UAVs, whereby cluster heads (CHs) collect data from their neighbor nodes while a UAV is sent out to collect data from CHs along the defined trajectory. The UAV-WSN system's energy consumption should be minimized during the data collection cycle. We formulate the task of reducing energy consumption as a constrained combinatorial optimization problem by selecting CHs from node inside clusters while arranging the UAV's visit order to the selected CHs concurrently. The problem of reducing energy consumption as defined is NP-hard, making the discovery of an optimal solution challenging. To address this issue, we present a deep DR approach we call the pointer network-A* (Ptr-A*), which can learn from experience the optimal UAV trajectory to minimize energy consumption. When given the UAV's beginning location and a wireless sensors network (WSN) with a specific number of groups, the Ptr-A* will construct a trajectory—a grouping of CHs with the visitation sequence to these CHs. The actor-critic method is used to train the Ptr-A*'s parameters in an unsupervised manner using problem samples gathered into small-scale clusters, which speeds up the learning process. In addition, three different search strategies are introduced to improve the accuracy of inferred results. By simulating several WSNs with variable cluster densities, we discover that models constructed utilizing 20-clusters to 40-clusters have a high generalization ability to deal with the UAV's intended trajectory problem. When compared to two established approaches, our brand-new DRL algorithm comes out on top.

We find that the suggested CNN approach is more successful in removing deviations from 2D PAT photos retrieved from sparse data compared to the standard UNet after contrasting the quality of restored pictures using both methods. An iterative optimization-based restoration framework incorporating two types of regularizations is developed for use in picture restoration. We test the suggested approach on phantoms as well as in vivo mice imaging, and the findings demonstrate a significant increase in picture quality and resolution.

abstract: Early detection of diabetic foot ulcer (DFU) can prevent foot amputation, related health complications and even early death. Accordingly, the Bluetooth transmission of the corresponding channel is replaced by a fixed character to save battery power. The processing flow consists of deep autoencoder based feature extraction, and random forest classifier for prediction, with the accuracy of 91% over 720 number of blind trials. The standalone deployment of processing pipeline in the ARM v6 controller required 10.39 kbytes of memory and 1.21 s to process 3 s sensor data for embedded reliability analysis. Future end-to-end connectivity of the sensing and analysis system can be useful for wearable health monitoring.

articleTitle: Effective Information Capture and Retrieval Through Machine Learning-Based Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Effective information capture and retrieval is crucial for organizations to meet their business needs and remain competitive in today's fast-paced digital world. Traditional information management systems, while useful, are often limited in their ability to handle large amounts of data and provide accurate and relevant results. This paper proposes the use of machine learning-based systems to enhance the process of information capture and retrieval. These systems leverage the power of artificial intelligence to automatically learn from data patterns and improve their performance over time. This approach has shown promising results in various industries, such as finance, healthcare, and e-commerce. Through the utilization of machine learning algorithms, organizations can achieve more efficient and accurate information capture and retrieval, leading to better decision-making and improved business outcomes. The benefits and challenges associated with using machine learning-based systems for information management are discussed, along with potential future research directions in this field. Overall, this paper highlights the importance of utilizing machine learning-based systems for effective information capture and retrieval and the potential impact they can have on organizational success.

articleTitle: Analysis and Mitigation of DDOS Vulnerabilities in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Cloud computing platforms offer increased uptime to the services and diverse compute and storage capabilities. The cloud providers charge users for the configuration of virtual machines. Although these devices may be online or offline, they could still have security issues. Infrastructures for cloud systems are important since they deal with accessibility, honesty, and secrecy. In order to provide cloud handlers with facilities without interruptions, security and accessibility are of utmost importance. This is because numerous privacy issues can disrupt cloud operations. One of the major dangers to cloud security is the Distributed Denial of Service attack, which is a severe worry. When genuine customers suffer major economic losses or data theft, the cloud's possessions are ruined and deal with the crucial elements that have a significant impact on the cloud environment. In order to obtain high protection for the users and fault-free processes, this study discusses the optimal model (Swarm Intelligence, i.e. PSO and firefly) for security analysis and threats' vulnerabilities into cloud computing environment.

articleTitle: Optimizing Mango Leaf Disease Evaluation: CNN and Random Forest Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The abstract presents a summary of the classification model's efficacy in assessing & categorizing mango leaf diseases using various Relevance Ratings. The table summarizes critical metrics for each Relevance Rating, including precision, recall, F1-Score, support, support proportion, and accuracy, demonstrating the model's resilience and effectiveness. Precision, which measures positive prediction accuracy, consistently produces exceptional results ranging from 94.79% to an astonishing 97.00%, indicating the model's ability to make exact positive predictions with few errors. Similarly, recall, which measures the model's ability to detect true positive cases, has remained consistently dependable, ranging between 95.10% to 96.41%. These data highlight the model's ability to correctly identify actual positive cases. The F1-Score, an equal amount of precision with recall, consistently shows the model's brilliance, with values that range from 95.29% to 96.08% providing a thorough assessment of the model's overall classification capacity. The dataset contains 4940 photos, and our model obtained a remarkable overall accuracy of 95.74%, indicating its utility in agricultural disease control. The support values show a wellbalanced dataset spanning Relevance Ratings, which reinforces the model's dependability and consistency. The model's capacity to reliably identify and diagnose mango leaf illnesses is shown by weighted average metrics that are regularly at 95.75%, highlighting its high-quality performance. In conclusion, the model's excellent accuracy and dependability make it a significant tool for the successful categorization of mango leaf diseases, with deep implications for agricultural disease control and mango crop quality development, ensuring a positive future for mango farming.

articleTitle: Leaf Watch: An Innovative Multi-Class Pre-Trained Model for Untying the Spectrum of Maize Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Corn is well recognized as a crucial staple crop globally. However, the prevalence of several corn diseases poses significant challenges in terms of accurate diagnosis, particularly for planting workers who rely only on experiential knowledge. In the majority of cases, diseases of plants often result in the failure of crops. The utilization of deep learning and image recognition techniques for identifying plant diseases has emerged as a significant area of research, owing to the advancements in computer technology. This study employed a Convolutional Neural Network utilizing the ResNet34 model for the classification of corn disease into four classes: Blight, Common rust, Grey Leaf spot and Healthy class. The present research has been conducted on the Plant Village dataset. The evaluation of transfer learning models involves the consideration of five metrics: accuracy, precision, recall, F-score, and loss. These metrics serve as indicators to analyze the performance of TL models. Each of the four categories was identified, yielding a mean accuracy of 97.6%, an average precision value of 94% and an f-1 score of 0.93. The observed values of these performance indicators indicate the potential for developing and implementing apps that might assist farmers and plant pathologists in efficiently and reliably identifying diseases and administering appropriate treatments.

articleTitle: Text Mining for Intelligent Information Processing and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: textual content Mining is the process of extracting meaningful information from large volumes of unstructured text. it's far a form of synthetic intelligence used to investigate and interpret files along with consumer feedback, emails, transcripts, net logs, surveys, and on line documents. Its intention is to discover hidden shape, patterns, institutions, and correlations in textual facts in order to draw inferences and broaden new insights. textual content Mining allows a deeper level of intelligence and selection-making by means of uncovering which means from unstructured textual facts. by means of utilising present day statistical strategies and herbal Language Processing (NLP), text Mining can produce automatic fashions that interpret and translate textual content into intelligent information which can be used to make correct predictions and provide actionable insights. textual content Mining is also being used to find out new trends, categorize client sentiment, locate correlations in purchaser comments, and section document collections. eventually, text Mining is being used to assist automate selection-making by automating workflows, processing massive volumes of text in a fragment of time, and providing deep insights into patron conversations.

articleTitle: Cataract Disease Severity Prediction: A Hybrid CNN and Random Forest Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The study's abstract provides a thorough analysis of the model's effectiveness in classifying various disease intensities. A structured table providing essential indicators for each degree of disease intensity is used to present this summary and divides the data into groups. The precision ratings, which range between 86.22% to 96.74%, demonstrate how well the models can produce positive predictions that are correct over a broad range of disease categories. This indicates that models are proficient in accurately recognizing cases with the given level of illness severity. The models' efficacy in identifying true positive cases is further demonstrated by the recall scores, which range between 87.94% to 92.79%. This further highlights the models' capacity for illness identification. The F1 results show that overall model performance falls between 88.91% and 93.29%. These ratings take into account both precision and recall. This range shows a well-balanced performance, achieving a balance between the models' capacity to detect genuine positive cases accurately and prevent false positives. Apart from these performance indicators, the table offers information on support proportions and values. These numbers show the distribution and make-up of the dataset that was used to assess the models. After a thorough evaluation with a dataset of 4628 photos, the models achieved an astounding 91.18% overall accuracy. Moreover, the model's ability to correctly classify disease intensity is highlighted by the weighted average accuracy of 91.21%, highlighting the importance of precision and recall as crucial performance indicators. Finally, the abstract summarizes the key findings of the study clearly and concisely, demonstrating the models' strong performance in accurately and successfully classifying a wide range of disease intensities, which makes them useful instruments for disease diagnosis.

articleTitle: PPG Signal-Based Activity Recognition for Health and Fitness Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Photoplethysmography (PPG), commonly integrated into wearable devices, is widely utilized for detecting human activities and various physiological parameters. This study focuses on employing a feature-oriented and prime feature selection-based methodology in tandem with machine learning models like SVM and Decision Tree for effectively classifying human activities using wrist PPG data. The research underscores a clear relationship between essential features, relevant data points of features, their importance on target, and accurate classification of human activities derived from the PPG signals. The proposed approach demonstrates high accuracy, achieving 96.7% and 91.0% in two publicly available datasets. These results provide strong evidence of the efficiency and potential of features-based machine learning approaches in human activity classification from PPG signals.

articleTitle: Identifying Customer Churn Patterns Using Machine Learning Predictive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Customer churn, often known as customer attrition, is a prevalent issue faced by businesses operating in many sectors. The accurate anticipation and mitigation of customer churn is of utmost importance to maintain a dedicated clientele and ensure sustained profitability over an extended period. This study proposes a novel machine learning (ML) methodology for predicting customer churn using past customer data, including transactional records, customer characteristics, and interaction behaviors. Feature engineering techniques, such as the ReliefF method, are utilized to ascertain the significance of features and determine the optimal 14 features for training machine learning models. The data undergoes preprocessing to identify and impute the missing values before training the ML models. The results emphasize the effectiveness of ML models in identifying patterns and trends in consumer behavior, which allows for preventive actions to reduce customer attrition and improve customer satisfaction and loyalty. The highest training and testing accuracy of 96.6% and 100%, respectively, is achieved by the XGBoost. This study makes a valuable contribution to the advancement of a reliable churn prediction system, which has the potential to assist organizations in the identification of customers who are in danger of leaving and in the implementation of focused retention tactics.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Web Security Measures for Protecting Wireless Networks from Malicious Attack
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This technical abstract is an analysis of internet security features for shielding Wi-Fi networks from malicious assaults. The main objective of this evaluation is to perceive the best security features for defensive a wireless community, and to determine which of the net protection alternatives are the best and within your means. The evaluation makes use of each quantitative and qualitative studies methods to degree different factors which includes cost, inconvenience, implementation complexity, and safety warranty. After an extensive assessment of the present net protection alternatives, its miles concluded that a combination of encryption, authentication, firewalls, access control lists, and antivirus/anti-malware software is the maximum efficient approach for preserving a wireless community secure from malicious assaults. Furthermore, the most excellent security features depend upon the size, complexity, and price range of the corporation, and ought to be tailor-made to fulfill the precise needs of the employer.

articleTitle: Estimation Analysis of Edge and Line Detection Methods in Digital Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This paper provides an estimation evaluation of the area and line detection methods in virtual photo processing. This analysis evaluates the performance of numerous facet and line detection algorithms in phrases of facet/line first-rate, accuracy, computational complexity, and robustness to noise in the context of artificial and actualinternational snapshots. Mainly, it discusses the overall performance of 4 edge detection methods: Roberts, Prewitt, Sobel, and Canny; and 3 line detection techniques: Hough remodel, Linear Estimation, and Probabilistic Hough remodel. as compared to the classical algorithms, the Probabilistic Hough rework algorithm is determined to have the excellent accuracy and robustness to noise. Furthermore, a contrast of computational complexities shows that the Hough transform has the bottom complexity and computational time, even as the Linear Estimation algorithm has the best complexity and computational time. The primary outcome of this study is that the brink/line first-rate, accuracy, computational complexity, and robustness are very dependent on the sort of entered snapshots and the respective selected parameters.

articleTitle: Celestial Insights: An Innovative Convolutional Neural Network for High-Resolution Satellite Remote Sensing Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The utilization of satellite remote sensing has become an essential instrument for monitoring and understanding the ever-changing landscapes of the Earth. Accurate categorization of satellite imagery plays a crucial role in fully leveraging its diverse range of applications in the fields of environment and geography. This study classifies satellite images into four unique categories: cloudy, water, desert, and green region. This research introduces a novel Convolutional Neural Network architecture specifically designed to effectively identify and differentiate the distinct features of various terrains in satellite data. To assess the robustness of our methodology, the performance measures of our model are compared with those of the highly regarded VGG16 model. The Satellite Remote Sensing Image dataset has been utilized for the training and testing of both models. This dataset contains 5631 images belonging to four classes. The findings are highly persuasive: the customized convolutional neural network model demonstrated a remarkable accuracy rate of 98%, surpassing the VGG16 model's accuracy of 92%. This highlights the potential advantages of developing tailored models for distinct categorization tasks in the field of satellite remote sensing. This study contributes to the advancement of approaches used in satellite image classification and serves as a catalyst for future research in the development of customized models for complex classification challenges.

articleTitle: The ANN Algorithm-Optimized Deep Learning Model for Predicting Lung Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Lung cancer is one of the leading causes of mortality globally, and it affects both men and women equally. Lung cancer patients have a dismal prognosis and therefore high fatality rates. Automating processes using image recognition and analytics software is happening in the IT industry and the medical area. This study evaluates three distinct approaches to early lung cancer detection, including a support vector machine (SVM), with the MultiScale Deep Convolutional Neural System to see which is most effective at saving lives. The lung cancer patient files kept at University of California at Irvine are the primary source for the data indices utilized in this investigation. In order to determine which classification algorithm works best in practice, this study uses the WEKA Tools to conduct empirical research. Multi-Scale DCNN achieves 95.56 percent accuracy, then followed by SVM (92.11) with KNN (88.40 percent) based on the data.

articleTitle: Utilizing Cooperative Spectrum Sharing for High Speed Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Cooperative spectrum sharing is a method to allocate the radio spectrum amongst users for high-velocity wireless networks. It entails multiple unbiased customers that cooperate to percentage their respective spectra to maximize the records fee and the practical spectrum usage. The cooperative spectrum sharing technique lets non-overlapping frequency bands be utilized by multiple customers supplying a high statistics fee with minimum interference. It affords a green way of handling the radio spectrum, permitting multiple customers to share the to-be-had spectrum sources rather than having an unmarried consumer monopolize an upbeat frequency band. Cooperative spectrum sharing is likewise tremendous because of its low implementation cost and occasional power intake. Furthermore, it could be fast deployed to numerous areas to meet the increasing demand for excessive-speed Wi-Fi networks.

articleTitle: Adaptive Time-Triggered Network-on-Chip Architecture: Enhancing Safety
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Real-time computing systems are designed to meet strict timing constraints and respond to events or inputs within specific deadlines. These systems are commonly used in safety-critical applications such as spacecraft, medical devices, industrial control, and automotive systems. Engineers rely on various scheduling techniques to ensure that timing constraints are met. One such technique is static allocation in time-triggered systems. This technique offers valuable advantages in terms of system safety and dependability. It enables efficient resource usage in Network-on-Chip (NoC) architectures by minimizing message congestion and contention. However, its static nature can present limitations in terms of fault tolerance. This paper focuses on developing and evaluating fault tolerance techniques tailored for NoC-based multi-core architectures to enhance safety. It introduces adaptation techniques that tolerate permanent faults within the time-triggered NoC architecture. Additionally, the paper outlines the incorporation of seamless redundancy mechanisms at the network interface (NI) level, specifically designed to tolerate transient faults that may occur within NoC components, such as routers and links. These mechanisms play a crucial role in safeguarding critical data, further enhancing the reliability and safety of real-time systems in safety-critical applications.

articleTitle: Leveraging Neural Networks to Enhance Large-Scale Data Processing Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Recent advances in neural networks have enabled them to become powerful tools in data processing for tasks such as pattern recognition and classification. This has enabled neural networks to be applied to large-scale data processing problems, where they have been shown to perform very well. However, due to the large amount of data involved in such tasks, it is essential that the processing performance is also improved. This paper presents several methods to leverage available resources such as distributed computing and improved algorithmic techniques to improve the performance of large-scale data processing tasks using neural networks. Examples of such techniques are given for both supervised and unsupervised learning tasks, which can significantly enhance the performance of large-scale data processing applications. The results of several experiments are presented, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed techniques. The authors also provide insights for future work that could further enhance the capabilities of neural networks when applied to large-scale data processing applications.

articleTitle: Network Coding for End-to-End Connectivity in Underwater High Speed Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Community coding is a critical generation advanced in recent years for enhancing stop-to-give-up connectivity in underwater excessive-pace communication networks. It permits a couple of nodes to trade their data more efficiently, creating a network that is more remarkably resilient to packet loss. Underwater high speed communication networks are essential for a wide range of applications, such as oceanographic data collection, offshore exploration, and underwater surveillance. However, these networks are subject to various challenges, including limited bandwidth, high error rates, and long propagation delays. Network coding has emerged as a promising solution for improving end-to-end connectivity in these challenging environments. This technique allows nodes in the network to combine multiple data packets into a single coded packet, increasing the robustness of the network and improving data transmission efficiency. In this abstract, we review the current state of network coding in underwater high speed communication networks and discuss its potential to enhance end-to-end connectivity. We also highlight ongoing research efforts and potential future directions for the application of network coding in this domain. Through our analysis, we demonstrate the significant potential of network coding for achieving reliable and efficient communication in underwater high speed networks. Moreover, community coding generation makes use of small blocks of bits, which makes it more power-green than traditional techniques. Similarly, the use of network coding is augmented through the development of novel circulate-layer protocols.

articleTitle: Utilizing Dynamic Spectrum Allocation to Optimize Capacity in High-Speed Fiber Optic Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Dynamic spectrum allocation can extensively improve the ability of high-speed fiber optic communications, permitting Fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) and different deployments to be optimized for max performance. This approach makes use of a decentralized approach to allocate spectrum resources on demand, taking into account scalability and efficient aid usage. With the aid of the use of a restrained set of hardware and software, dynamic spectrum allocation can quick and correctly update the communications community to meet changing demands. This generation takes gain of the increasingly more sophisticated optical additives available these days to alter the spectrum in real time rather than relying on static allocation algorithms. This capability reduces the want to frequently reassign spectrum allocations, in addition to the amount of time and sources it requires, permitting the communications network to be managed and controlled extra efficiently and efficiently. Moreover, dynamic spectrum allocation improves the overall performance of current fiber communications structure with the aid of better using current optical components, which may be applied retroactively.

articleTitle: Severity Levels of Apple Disease Recognition Using CNN and Random Forest: An Integrated Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The primary objective of this research is to examine the critical undertaking of promptly identifying and categorising apple leaf diseases within the context of precision agriculture. The cornerstone of this study is a diversified dataset consisting of 4,976 photos collected from several digital platforms. The suggested model is a precisely built combination of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Random Forest, which incorporates special architectural characteristics. Results showed an overall accuracy of 72.50%, illustrating the model's competence in illness identification. The metrics of precision, recall, and F1-score provide a thorough assessment of the performance of the system across all degrees of illness severity. The integration of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Random Forests in the model capitalises on the respective advantages of each, hence exhibiting potential for wider use in the field of agriculture. The current study signifies a notable progression in the field of automated plant disease identification, hence making a valuable contribution towards improving crop management and promoting sustainability in the domain of precision agriculture.

articleTitle: Recommendation Systems: Enhancing Personalization and Customer Experience
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In the ever-evolving landscape of e-commerce, the integration of recommendation systems has emerged as a pivotal system for refining personalization strategies and elevating customer experiences. This study delves into the dynamic interplay between recommendation systems and business success, with a two-fold focus. Firstly, an exploration of existing methodologies unveils the diverse spectrum of approaches applied in shaping recommendation systems based on session behavior, sentiment analysis, geographic location, and gender preferences. This comprehensive analysis seeks to refine valuable insights from previous works, offering a panoramic view of how these systems have evolved to cater to individual customer preferences. Building on this foundation, the study introduces a cutting-edge Recommendation System Framework. This framework strategically combines the intricate facets of user session dynamics, sentiment nuances, geographical context, and gender inclinations. Through this synthesis, a novel blueprint emerges, poised to revolutionize ecommerce recommendations by seamlessly aligning business goals with personalized user interactions. In essence, this research not only underscores the strategic significance of recommendation systems but also establishes a forwardlooking paradigm for businesses to drive engagement, loyalty, and unparalleled customer satisfaction within the realm of online commerce.
