articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Smoking Detection System For Public Areas
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Cigarette smoking continues to be a major worldwide health concern, with multiple negative implications for both people and society. Effective surveillance and early identification of smokers are critical steps in tackling this public health issue. This study employs deep learning CNN architecture to create a robust and accurate system for recognising cigarette smokers in public areas. In the research, a large collection of face photos was obtained from both smokers and nonsmokers, assuring variety in age, gender, and ethnicity. For feature extraction and classification, we used the convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture, a well-established deep learning model. The experimental findings illustrate the efficiency of the suggested technique, with a remarkable accuracy rate of 90% in discriminating cigarette smokers from non-smokers. Furthermore, the model's performance was assessed using important measures such as accuracy, recall, and F1-score, demonstrating its ability to balance false positives and false negatives.

articleTitle: The Wireless Network Signal Detection Using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Over the last decade, deep learning (DL) applications have exploded in the realm of wireless communications, particularly in the realms of channel estimation and signal identification. However, traditional DL methods need training for each new circumstance. As a result, updating to new wireless systems necessitates retraining. The acquisition of sufficient training data to achieve adequate detection efficiency may be time-consuming and expensive. Traditional DL methods sometimes need extensive amounts of time to train, even if substantial amounts of training data are available. Because of this, it's possible that DL approaches' efficacy and robustness may suffer. This letter presents a transfer learning architecture that may use information gained from an original system to enhance the training procedure of a target system that has access to less data for its training. In regards to channel estimation as well as signal identification, our simulation results show that the suggested solution is superior to state-of-the-art deep learning approaches.

articleTitle: Exploration of Informatization Practice of Constructed English Learning Platform based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The role of platform informatization in constructed English learning is very important, but there is a problem that the information combination is not ideal. The English professional teaching mode cannot solve the problem of platform informatization in structured English learning education, and the informatization is not perfect. Therefore, this paper proposes a genetic algorithm for the information analysis of English learning platform. Firstly, the education and teaching theory is used to informatize the constructed English learning platform, and the indicators are carried out according to the requirements of the platform informatization Divide and reduce interference factors in platform informatization. Then, the education and teaching theory informatizes the constructed English learning platform, forms a platform informatization scheme, and conducts the platform informatization results Comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that under the condition that the information standard is certain, the genetic algorithm has the integrity of the platform for constructive English learning the platform information scheme is better than the English professional teaching mode.

articleTitle: Research on Budget Management System of Power Supply Enterprises Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Budget management is an important item in power supply enterprises. Budget management is an indispensable part of enterprise management and a symbol of scientific management of enterprises. It plays a vital role in the development of power supply enterprises. Traditional budgeting methods cannot solve the problem of accurate budget management in power supply enterprises. Therefore, this paper proposes a data mining technique for budget management analysis. With the rapid development of information age, data has become one of the important resources of modern enterprises. As the basic industry of national economy, power supply enterprises produce a large amount of data in their business operation and management. How to effectively use these data to improve the management efficiency and decision-making level of enterprises has become an important problem faced by power supply enterprises. As a powerful data analysis tool, data mining technology can extract valuable information from massive data and provide powerful support for enterprise decision-making. This paper will discuss the influence of data mining technology on budget management of power supply enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Learning Model of Higher Vocational Education Under the Background of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, artificial intelligence technology has gradually penetrated into various fields, including education. Higher vocational education is an important part of higher education, and its educational model and methods are constantly being reformed and innovated. As a new educational concept and method, the core idea of adaptive learning is to provide customized learning resources and paths for learners according to their individual needs and characteristics. The introduction of artificial intelligence technology has brought new opportunities and challenges for adaptive learning in higher vocational education. This paper will discuss the influence, steps and methods of artificial intelligence on adaptive learning in higher vocational education.

articleTitle: Integrated Control Platform for Power Plants Based on Advanced Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Under the background of the development and progress of science and technology, the power plant has integrated advanced technology into the process of equipment control and developed an integrated control platform. However, the traditional integrated control platform cannot control the equipment more accurately. With the continuous progress and development of science and technology, the integrated control technology of thermal power plants is also constantly updated and improved. This paper will introduce the application of advanced algorithms in the integrated control of thermal power plants, including the content, method, process and results. the integrated control platform based on advanced algorithms is the integrated control platform of the power plant The control accuracy and control platform improvement are better than the traditional integrated control platform.

Author Keywords: Integrated control platform based on advanced algorithms

articleTitle: Application and Practice of Bayesian Algorithm in Experimental Teaching of Applied Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Since the 21st century, people have made great progress in the research of artificial intelligence. As an important method to express uncertain knowledge, Bayesian network has become one of the hot spots and important achievements in artificial intelligence research. Building an effective Bayesian network structure is also the basis and core of learning and applying Bayesian network. This research aims to introduce the application of Bayesian algorithm (BA) in mathematics teaching. BA can be used to supplement or replace the standard learning method of mathematics. In order to enable students to learn more effectively, teachers need to know which methods are effective and how to apply these methods to improve students' learning. This paper aims to apply Bayesian method to experimental learning environment. The study provides findings, conclusions and recommendations.

articleTitle: Facilitating Data Use: Achieving Maximum Efficiency with AI-Enhanced Information Capture and Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The extraordinary boom of data keeps to undertaking the conventional methods to information usage. the use of synthetic intelligence (AI) and gadget studying (ML) is reworking how information is captured and used, as businesses increasingly more undertake a zero-believe approach to garage and retrieval of records. this article explores the ability of AI-enhanced data capture and retrieval to assist groups unleashes the price of their facts with the intention to maximize performance. It covers the basics of AIbased facts capture and retrieval, inclusive of photo popularity, speech reputation, optical character recognition, and herbal language processing (NLP). It additionally examines the effective implications of AI-improved statistics use, in addition to capacity troubles which can prevent or put off its adoption. sooner or later, the thing affords insights into how organizations can equip themselves with the essential AI-based skills to optimize their facts use and selection-making processes.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Filtering Recommendation Algorithm Based on Fuzzy Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In e-commerce, it is very important to understand the preferences of users to better personalize services. Therefore, the recommendation system is particularly important, and the traditional collaborative filtering algorithm in the recommendation system cannot better solve the accuracy problem in the recommendation system. Therefore, this paper proposes a collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on fuzzy clustering for recommendation system analysis. Firstly, fuzzy clustering is used to cluster items in e-commerce, and indicators are divided according to the requirements of the recommendation system to reduce the recommendation system in the interfering factor. Then, fuzzy clustering optimizes the personalized service recommendation system to form a recommendation system scheme and performs the recommendation system results Comprehensive analysis. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, the collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on fuzzy clustering has a good effect on the accuracy of the recommendation system of personalized services. The recommendation accuracy of the recommendation system is better than that of the traditional collaborative filtering algorithm.

Author Keywords: Collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on fuzzy clustering

articleTitle: Multi-Feature Fusion for Soil Image Feature Extraction and Classification Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Classification of the soil is one of the essential agricultural tasks for effective yield. Generally, soil classification has been done using conventional laboratory methods, which are time-consuming and high-cost. Computer-aided image analysis and artificial intelligence play a prominent role in classifying objects. This paper uses soil images to classify the soil type to overcome the long computational time and high cost. The texture of the soil is a critical factor in deciding the soil type. In this research, we proposed a multi-feature fusion in soil image feature extraction and classification using machine learning (ML). The soil samples were gathered from various regions of Andhra Pradesh, India, and images were captured by following certain criteria. The texture features: Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix, Tamura, Gabor filter banks, and HSV texture features are fused to identify the soil type. The fused features are used in classifying the soil images using machine learning (ML) algorithms. The performance analyses in classifying the soil type using the Gaussian-kernel Support Vector Machine are better when compared with other ML algorithms.

articleTitle: An Efficient Fine-Tuned Convolutional Neural Network Model for Tea Leaf Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The Indian population heavily relies on agricultural income, and unfortunately, pests and plant diseases exert a substantial negative impact on it. Protocols for interoperability across blockchains are crucial to their capacity to communicate with one another. abstract: The increasing integration of technology in automotive systems has led to the widespread adoption of remote keyless entry systems for vehicles. However, the convenience of such systems is accompanied by security challenges, as unauthorized access to vehicles poses a significant threat. This project proposes a robust solution to enhance the security of remote keyless entry systems by leveraging advanced encryption algorithms, namely AES-CTR and ChaCha20. The primary focus is on generating rolling codes with time stamp that ensure secure communication between the key fob and the car, effectively preventing unauthorized access. A Remote Keyless Entry System is a method of locking or unlocking the doors remotely, without the use of a physical key. Rolling codes provide secure communication between the sender and the receiver by generating a new code each time the key fob is used to unlock the system. AES CTR algorithm provides secure encryption of the rolling code by generating a stream cipher that is XORed with the plaintext to produce the ciphertext. ChaCha20 encryption algorithm provides a secure transmission of the rolling code over the wireless channel by encrypting the ciphertext with a shared key. The proposed solution ensures secure and reliable communication between the sender and receiver, preventing unauthorized access.

To address this, transfer learning is proposed using the pretrained Arabic BERT model ArabERT. ArabERT leverages BERT's bidirectional representations to model linguistic context. ArabERT is fine-tuned on the Levantine dataset for hate speech classification. Results show ArabERT significantly outperforms machine learning models, attaining 90% accuracy and 94% Fl-score specifically for hate speech detection. Detailed analysis demonstrates ArabERT's contextual modeling enables nuanced discernment between offensive and hateful tweets. The outcomes provide strong evidence that transfer learning approaches like ArabERT are crucial for handling informal multi-dialect Arabic. abstract: In contemporary times, traditional marketing methods have transformed, giving way to online marketing approaches that necessitate internet connectivity. Online marketing strategies offer numerous benefits, particularly in terms of cost-effectiveness and expeditious dissemination of information to the general populace. Nevertheless, one of the primary issues faced by firms in the realm of Internet marketing pertains to the identification of appropriate target consumers. This is because if organizations mistakenly target consumers not aligned with their products or services, it can result in ineffective marketing efforts and waste of resources. This research thoroughly examines ad click prediction and classification through a machine learning (ML)-based novel approach. Predictive models are developed by utilizing past ad interaction data, encompassing user demographics, ad features, and contextual information. The proposed method identifies the important factors driving ad-click behavior more easily using feature engineering approaches to extract pertinent patterns and correlations from the data by using the Pearson correlation method. Among all the implemented algorithms, the highest accuracy of 97.5% and AUC of 0.996 on test data is achieved by the logistic regression classifier. This research adds to the body of knowledge that will help advertisers pinpoint their ideal target demographic, fine-tune their ad placement techniques, and make the most of the resources they have at their disposal.

articleTitle: Enhancing Epileptic Seizure Detection Through Advanced Artificial Intelligence Analysis of EEG Signals

abstract: Epilepsy is a chronic neurological disorder characterized by recurrent, unprovoked seizures resulting from abnormal electrical activity in the brain. This study aimed to enhance the diagnostic accuracy of detecting epileptic seizures by applying sophisticated analytical techniques, including machine learning and deep learning, to electroencephalogram (EEG) data. we performed comprehensive preprocessing on a standardized dataset of EEG records from 100 subjects, with 50 diagnosed with epilepsy and 50 classified as non-epileptic controls. A mix of user education, technical controls, and automated detection systems can be used to prevent phishing attempts, which are crucial for preserving cybersecurity. This research paper introduces a reliable methodology that utilises Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) that have been trained on the Sokoto Coventry Fingerprint Dataset (SOCOFing). The CNN model demonstrates a remarkable accuracy of 99.78% in accurately discerning between authentic and manipulated fingerprints. The use of hierarchical characteristics collected by convolutional layers is employed to identify small modifications. Data augmentation is used to improve the generalisation capability. The metrics of precision, recall, and F1-score provide an assessment of the model's efficacy in accurately identifying different types of alterations, such as partial modifications, picture splicing, and presentation assaults, with a high level of accuracy and resilience. This study places significant emphasis on the ongoing enhancement of fingerprint modification detection, which is of utmost importance given the constant evolution of spoofing tactics. abstract: A worldwide crop, sunflowers are subject to illnesses that can reduce productivity and quality. Agriculture needs early and precise disease diagnosis to control and reduce economic losses. We initially collected sunflower leaf photos of healthy and diseased leaves, including Alternaria leaf blight, Downy mildew, Phoma blight, and Verticillium wilt. Resizing, contrast modification, and color improvement improve dataset quality and consistency. Phase two comprises data separation and feature extraction. The dataset has training, validation, and testing sets, and a pre-trained CNN model extracts key picture attributes. CNN penultimate layer features are used for categorization. Disease categorization neural network architecture is devised and executed in the third step. This design uses three convolutional layers for feature extraction, three max-pooling layers for dimension reduction, and one fully connected layer for classification. Optimized network structure extracts relevant features and makes accurate predictions. After extracting neural network features, Support Vector Machines (SVMs) are classified in the fourth step. Our model is assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and confusion matrices. On the same dataset, we compare our technique to others. articleTitle: The Heterogeneous Wireless Sensor Networks: An Energy-Efficient Cooperative Routing Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In order for data packets in wireless sensor networks, or WSNs to reach their final destinations, or sinks, several routing mechanisms must be used. Sensors are used in the real world to keep track of things like weather and security threats. Most WSNs are able to identify unique environmental occurrences. However, several WSNs may use a variety of sensors to keep tabs on a variety of events simultaneously. Thermal sensors/meters monitor interior and outdoor conditions, body-temperature sensors detect intruders, etc., when used in a wireless sensor network (WSN) for a smart home. In addition, a health WSN is installed underground, making use of physiological sensors to track patients' vitals. This means that there might be many WSNs serving distinct functions in the same location. At the moment, the data transmission from each WSN is done separately. Simply put, the delivery efficiency may be improved due to the large number of available sensors for packet relay if all sensors in a situation like this multi-WSNs environment are able to share routing paths/nodes as well as relay event messages for other WSNs. Since the amount of energy required for wireless transmission grows with the square of the distance between the transmitter and receiver, this allows for more efficient transmission. In a heterogeneous sensors network, several WSNs share the same physical space, and each sensor forwards packets both inside and to other WSNs. To conserve energy, we propose this cooperative routing scheme, which we call Energy-Efficient Cooperative Routing Program for Heterogeneous Wireless Sensing Networks (EERH for short). The proposed method groups each User Equipment (UE) into a Main Cluster (MC) and Sub Cluster (SC) and selects Cluster Heads (CHs) based on maximum residual energy. These cluster heads then establish connections to the Base Station (BS) located in the Functional Area (FA) through the Relay Node (RN). The developed model achieved a precision and recall rates of 98 % and 95 %, respectively. Additionally, the developed severity estimation model with the custom metric demonstrated promising results, with a maximum absolute difference of 0.5 between the ground truth severity measure and the predicted severity measure. This paper introduces an innovative approach to enhance energy extraction from solar panels during low irradiance periods using a FieldProgrammable Gate Array (FPGA) controller. The virtual panel is to be integrated with the original photovoltaic array which, exhibits the characteristics of the original photovoltaic array. abstract: In recent years, the use of electricity has gradually increased, and due to the use of inductive and nonlinear loads, the reactive power has increased significantly, and the power system has become unbalanced, resulting in an increase in power quality problems. This shows that reactive power measurement is very important in power systems. Traditional measurement methods cannot accurately measure reactive power in power systems. Therefore, a Hilbert digital filter is proposed for reactive power measurement and analysis. First, digital technology is used to measure reactive power, and indicators are divided according to the requirements of reactive power measurement to reduce interference factors in reactive power measurement. Then, digital technology forms a reactive power measurement scheme based on the reactive power measurement results of the power system, and comprehensively analyzes the reactive power measurement results. reliability of reactive power measurement of Hilbert digital filter for power system are superior to traditional measurement methods.

articleTitle: iCBR Techniques Enabled Cervical Intraepithelial Neoplasia Detection System (CINDS)

abstract: Intelligent Case based reasoning (iCBR) is a method that relies on the memory-centered cognitive model and stresses how people learn new skills or make conclusions about unfamiliar situations based on their prior experiences. iCBR is one of many Artificial Intelligence tracks that has shown considerable promise in the applications of intelligent systems in a variety of sectors, particularly in the field of healthcare, due to its intrinsic resemblance to human reasoning. articleTitle: A Containerized Cloud Computing Environments with Heterogeneous Task Co-Location
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: While microservices are able to process and communicate using lightweight techniques, finer tasks result in far more complex precedence restrictions. There is a wide range in the settings and costs of VMs (Virtual Machines) since different jobs have varying resource needs. In this study, we focus on the challenge of reducing the overall cost of renting by allocating the microservice activities of workflow tools to containers set up on demand virtual machines. Integer programming is used to create a mathematical model of the issue, and a foundation for an algorithm is presented. A task arranging heuristic is described for scheduling tasks with precedence constraints or separate assignments to available containers in response to resource needs that change over time. The Evaluation of Variance method is used to statistically calibrate all parameters and parts of the suggested algorithm framework on a large sample of random occurrences. The effectiveness of the suggested method is tested in several examples.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Powered Enhancement of Financial Network Security Through AI-Based Tools

abstract: The objective of this study is to examine the key factors that contribute to the enhancement of financial network security through the utilization of blockchain technology and artificial intelligence (AI) tools. Our research aims to enhance the comprehension of the intricate relationship between blockchain technology and AI tools in bolstering financial network security by revealing the network connections among crucial aspects. The aforementioned findings can be utilized as a valuable resource for facilitating future joint endeavors with the objective of enhancing financial inclusion and fostering community well-being. articleTitle: Flash MX-Based “Computer Graphics” Straight-Line Generation Algorithm Demonstrates the Design of the System

articleTitle: Research on Network Reliability and Fault Reconstruction Algorithm of Aircraft Power Distribution System

articleTitle: Phishing Site Detection Using Logistic Regression and Fine Tuning It Using Various Optimization Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Cybercriminals frequently prefer to deceive people into compromising their own security than using exploits or complex assaults to get access to networks. No matter what technological safeguards are in place, this strategy can be very effective. To conceal their actions and get around conventional security measures, economic resources through phishing attempts might leverage encrypted connections, such as HTTPS. This kind of intrusion has been detected and is being prevented by machine learning technologies. Using two different algorithms (Logistic Regression and Multinomial Naive Bayes) to analyse the URLs and various datasets to compare the results with previous research, we suggested a machine learning-based phishing detection system in this paper. The experimental findings show that the suggested models function superbly and have a high success rate in a social environment.

articleTitle: VGG 16 Pre-Trained Model for Early Detection of Retinal Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Retinal diseases present a substantial risk to the overall public health on a global scale. Conditions like diabetic retinopathy and age-related macular degeneration are prominent contributors to visual impairment and blindness. The timely identification of these diseases is imperative for implementing effective interventions and preventing irreversible visual impairment. Recently, there has been significant progress in utilizing deep learning techniques to automate the identification and assessment of retinal diseases through the Analysis of medical images. The research employs the VGG-16 pre-trained convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture as an effective tool for the timely identification of retinal diseases. The VGG-16 model, well-known for its deep architecture and exceptional feature extraction capabilities, has undergone fine-tuning using a diverse dataset of retinal images acquired from different imaging modalities. The pre-trained model demonstrates the capacity to aid clinicians in effectively detecting pathological characteristics indicative of retinal diseases during their initial stages. The Adam optimizer, renowned for its efficacy in training deep neural networks, optimizes the VGG 16 model. The training protocol consists of 16 epochs and utilizes a batch size 32. This specific choice of parameters was made based on its ability to strike a favorable balance between computational efficiency and the ability to converge toward optimal solutions. Consequently, the model can extract complex patterns and intricate features from input images, resulting in accurate classifications. The empirical findings demonstrate that the model can identify and categorize various forms of retinal diseases. The model exhibits a notable accuracy rate of 85%. This study contributes to the development of automated diagnostic tools within the domain of ophthalmology, potentially facilitating prompt and precise clinical evaluations by healthcare practitioners.

articleTitle: A High-Speed Sense Amplifier Based Flip Flop with a Single Ended Latch Design and Low Voltage Operating Capabilities
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This paper presents a sense amplifier-based flip flop (SAFF) with low power and high-speed operation capabilities. The power consumption and delay of FF improved after using the single-ended latch design. Contention and glitch-free operation are achieved through conditional cutoff. The study also shows a comparison of the modified SAFF with all previous flip-flops. The PDP of the modified SAFF improved to 60.7% compared to Jeong's SAFF, and the CK-Q delay improved to 44.6% compared to the MSFF. The modified SAFF provides operation even at very low voltages of 0.45 volts. The schematics of all SAFF are simulated using gdpk90nm technology in the Cadence Virtuoso tool.

articleTitle: An Evaluation and Implementation of the Effectiveness of Cloud Security as a Service in IoT Security
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The net of factors (IoT) has seen a speedy growth in current years, with more devices being linked to the internet daily. Those devices range from family home equipment to business systems, and their lavish use has made them appealing targets for cyber assaults. It poses a tremendous task for safety experts, as more than conventional safety features are frequently needed to guard IoT gadgets. To cope with this issue, many agencies are turning to Cloud protection as a carrier (Case) solution to beautify their IoT security. CSaaS is a cloud-primarily based protection solution that provides more than a few protection services, with chance detection, facts encryption, and the right of entry to manipulate IoT gadgets from cyber threats. It offers a scalable and value-powerful way to relax big numbers of IoT gadgets and can doubtlessly overcome the constraints of traditional security features. But, the effectiveness of Cases in IoT protection continues to be a topic of discussion. This paper aims to assess and implement the effectiveness of Cases in IoT security. It's going to begin by way of imparting an outline of the contemporary nation of IoT security and the challenges confronted in securing those devices. It will then discuss the concept of Cases and its capability benefits for IoT security. The paper may also evaluate current literature on Cases and their applicability to IoT protection

articleTitle: The Performance Analysis of Digital Signature Protocols for Enhancing Network Security

abstract: Comprehensive investigation the observation of virtual signature protocols and their position in making sure of community safety. The outcomes display that digital signature protocols can be used to enhance the safety of networks and applications. Via leveraging virtual signature protocols, its miles possible to acquire a more stage of network safety in comparison to traditional methods

articleTitle: Software Development for Vehicle Drivetrain Performance Simulation Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm

articleTitle: Single Well Casing Loss Prediction Method Based on Machine Learning

Then, the prediction theory predicts the casing loss of a single well, forms a single well casing loss prediction scheme, and predicts the result of the casing loss of a single well Conduct a comprehensive analysis. «The American Economic Review» shows that machine learning pairs under certain prediction criteria The prediction accuracy of single well casing loss and the prediction time of single well casing loss are better than that of neural network.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Different Predictive Models for Fouling Factor Prediction in HE
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This project presents a comparative analysis of different predictive models for fouling factor prediction in heat exchanger (HE). HE have use cases in the mechanical industry where they are used as a preheating device in the hydrotreating unit of oil refineries. If fouling is not detected in time, it leads to the HE shutdown and plant explosion. Frequent cleaning causes the loss of time, energy, and money. Therefore, in time prediction is necessary. Shell and tube heat exchanger (STHE) is used in this paper for prediction. Prediction models such as Multiple Linear Regression (MLR), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Random Forest, and Artificial Neural Network (ANN) algorithms are used. Through the notification, users will be notified to stop the operation and start the cleaning process. Power BI is used for visual analysis by integrating with the Python code. Comparative analysis is done for all four above-mentioned algorithms based on accuracy, time complexity, the efficiency of the algorithm, ease of training the model, space complexity, etc., to predict the fouling resistance. All types of scenarios are considered while predicting the fouling resistance such as temperature, U-Transfer rate, logarithmic mean temperature difference (LMTD), area, fluid flow rate increase or decrease in heat exchange. The accuracy of MLR and Random Forest are 98.9 % and 99.52 % and the R2 score of RNN and ANN are −34.81 & −0.395 respectively. R2 and accuracy are the performance measures of the model. The comparison of the results shows that the MLR-based approach can be successfully used for predicting the rate of fouling factor in the HEs for theupcoming 6 months.

articleTitle: An Intrusion Detection in Mobile Sensor Networks with Empowered Intruders Using k-Coverage as the Foundation for Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Intrusion detection in sensor networks is a difficult problem to solve. It has been proven that in static sensor systems, intrusion detection is improved by constructing sensor barriers utilizing random sensor deployment. In view of the recent surge of interest in mobile sensor applications, this study delves into the intrusion detection problem in a mobile sensors system, where it is anticipated that mobile sensors could improve barrier coverage. We focus in on protecting against mobile threats by erecting k-barriers. The necessity to record the paths of both sensors and intruders makes this a difficult challenge to solve. We begin by comparing this issue to the kinetic theory of gases developed during the classical era of physics. From there, we extrapolate the connection between sensor weight, detecting range, and sensors and intruder movement, all of which are critical system elements that affect barrier coverage performance. We do a correlation and sensitivity analysis on the system parameters to determine how many wireless sensors must be deployed for constant k-barrier coverage. Finally, we show that the same number of sensors may achieve much better coverage performance than in a static sensor environment.

articleTitle: A Discriminant Ensemble Classifier Model for Hybrid Feature Vector for Efficient Detection of Diseases in Mango Leaves
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Ensuring a healthy mango crop and stop infections from spreading, early diagnosis of mango illnesses is essential. Digital techniques for detecting mango diseases involve using technology to identify and monitor diseases in mango crops. These techniques can aid in early disease diagnosis and prompt action by farmers to stop the spread of illness. Digital techniques use various classifier for detecting mango diseases from extracted features of the segmented images like SVM, Naive bayes, Fine tree, neural networks etc. In this work three diseases namely anthracnose, black sooty mold and bacterial canker and healthy leaf images are taken. Images are pre processed by applying different techniques like denoising, edge sharping and pre processed images are colour segmented, from segmented images, feature vector was prepared with various features including colour, texture and geometric feature, which are classified by various available classifiers and results are compared and shows that ensemble classifier gives better results with proposed methodology.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Approach to Cyber Risk Assessment for Critical Information Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In this study, a sophisticated cyberattack model was created for real-time DDoS & MITM attacks. Clouds, servers, big data, and networks are only a few of the modern infrastructures where cyber threats have proliferated. Threats to these platforms mean that private information may have been compromised within their applications. Cyber security experts could choose from a plethora of tried-and-true static models, but they all fell short when faced with dynamic attacks and other, more complicated threats. Furthermore, earlier cybersecurity models had problems with both high-ToC and target-attack scalability. Using machine learning methods, this study develops a sophisticated model for evaluating cyber risks. The recommended Lite RFO model was built using a top-notch Python programming utility. This architecture has been used to monitor cyberattacks on any network and locate the specific attack with a reduced Tree of Controls (ToC). There was a substantial improvement in performance metrics like detection rate (98.43% ), accuracy (98.23% ), sensitivity (96.89%), and recall (94.56%).

articleTitle: Phishing Detection System Based on the SVM Active Learning Algorithm

abstract: This paper takes the phishing detection system as the object of discussion. In this regard, SVM active learning algorithm is selected in this paper to make up for the cost of high sample collection. articleTitle: Demand Prediction of Consumer Intention to Buy Edible Items Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Agriculture is a process of simplifying the food chain in nature and redistributing the resources for animals and plant production. It is the process of nurturing livestock and growing crops. It consists of preparing animal and plant items for human consumption and distributing them to marketplaces. A maximum number of textiles and food items in the world are produced by agriculture. In India, the primary source of income is agriculture. Various companies buy crops from the farmers and directly sell them to the consumers. As per a study by “The India Express”, there are 90–150 million farmers who rely on agriculture to run the expenses of their daily lives. Each day there is a huge amount of vegetable waste as their demand doesn't get predicted due to which a volume of vegetables gets rotten. So to deal with this issue, there is a need for the development of an automated model which can accurately predict the demand for vegetables for the next day based on the previous data. In this work, a framework has been developed for predicting the demand for okra and tomato for the next day, so that the farmers won't pluck too many vegetables and also keep track of daily sales. We have used four machine learning models namely, linear regression, decision tree, random forest, and logistic regression for identifying the demand for vegetables. In this experiment, two parameters %error and accuracy have been taken which shows that the decision tree model performs best with the highest accuracy of 99.62% and logistic regression has shown the least accuracy at 85.62%. This work can help various edible-based eCommerce companies for predicting the demand for the items for the next day based on the previous data.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Transmission Line Path Planning Based on Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With the development of smart grid, the path planning of digital transmission lines has become an important research direction. The path planning of transmission line is to determine the direction of transmission line reasonably according to the starting point and the end point of transmission line and various constraints along the way (such as terrain, environment, etc.). Hierarchical reinforcement learning is a new machine learning method, which divides the learning process into several levels, and each level can learn independently, thus improving the learning efficiency and effect. This paper will introduce the application of hierarchical reinforcement learning method in digital transmission line path planning.

articleTitle: A Steganographic Method Based on Pixel Block Differences in Grayscale Images
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Nowadays, protecting shared data from interception on public networks is critical. Steganography, an approach to concealing data, emerges as a practical remedy to confront this challenge. However, hiding confidential information within a digital medium, such as an image, often results in the degradation of visual quality. This decline can elicit suspicions among unauthorized users regarding the potential presence of concealed information. Over time, researchers have devised various steganographic algorithms to alleviate the substantial image distortion resulting from the data embedding process. Despite these endeavors, achieving a stego image of elevated quality that carries concealed data remains an enduring challenge. This study introduces a steganographic methodology grounded in the logic of difference expansion (DE), intending to augment the quality of the stego image for a specified payload size. The experimental outcomes showcase a Peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) reaching 62.7512 decibels (dB), underscoring the superior efficacy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: DDOS Intrusion Detection Using Hybrid ML Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The availability of networks and online services is seriously threatened by distributed denial of service (DDoS) assaults. Ensuring the ongoing functioning of online services requires the timely detection and mitigation of these assaults. This project presents a comprehensive report on the development and implementation of a DDoS intrusion detection system using a hybrid Machine Learning (ML) model. The main goal of the project is to combine the advantages of several machine learning techniques to improve the efficiency and accuracy of DDoS attack detection. The hybrid model combines supervised and unsupervised learning methods, such as K-Means Clustering, Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Deep Learning Neural Networks. The system can efficiently detect and categorize hostile traffic patterns by combining these models, which lowers false positives and enhances detection performance overall.

articleTitle: The Cluster Head Selection in Sectorized Wirelessly Powered Sensor Networks Using Geometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In this text, we'll go over a sectorized wirelessly driven sensor network (WPSN), whereby sensor nodes cluster by sector and communicate with the cluster head (CH) through a centralized energy supply. To maximize sensor data throughput, we model the entire sectorized WPSN and apply optimization and simulation to establish the optimal CH. In order to efficiently acquire the best CH, we perform an asymmetric geometrical assessment (GA) to determine the optimal CH coordinates within the region of the considered sector, so that only a tiny portion of nodes with sensors in proximity of this perfect collaborate requirements to be probed. The suggested GA-based CH selection approach drastically lowers the channel's feedback cost, and simulations demonstrate that it performs very near to the ideal.

articleTitle: Network Traffic Analysis and Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In the ever-changing world of network security, they've developed a cutting-edge intelligent network traffic analysis (ITA) system that places a premium on understanding the intricacies of each individual network packet. This cutting-edge approach allows the system to conduct deep-dive analyses of network data, making it highly sensitive to even the most subtle anomalies and potential network security breaches. Using cutting-edge ML techniques, such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs), Random Forest, Decision Tree, and LSTMs, their system shows remarkable flexibility in responding to the ever-evolving cyber threat landscape, uncovering complex patterns and relationships within the network data. This system is distinguished by its high level of accuracy achieved through packet level analysis and stringent pre-processing, as well as its utilization of high-quality packet-level data from tools like the Cisco packet Tracer platform or Wireshark's packet data, which helps improve network security by providing faster response times and fewer false positives. The easy integration of visualization tools also improves transparency, allowing network administrators and security professionals to make informed decisions and improve incident response efforts. The system also provides valuable insights into attacks, port scans, malicious activity, and unauthorized access attempts. In conclusion, their project stands as a beacon of innovation and protection in an era where network security reigns supreme, safeguarding networks against the ever-evolving cyber threat landscape.

articleTitle: Investigating the Effectiveness of Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Protocol in Wireless Network Security
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The Internet Key alternate (IKE) protocol is a widely used safety protocol for organizing comfy tunnels and encrypting visitors in wireless networks. The protocol is designed to authenticate and set up a relaxed conversation channel between two devices, usually a Wi-Fi entry to-point and a personal device. This paper researches the effectiveness of the IKE protocol in imparting security for wireless networks. The IKE protocol is primarily based on a mixture of crucial trade protocols, specifically the Internet Security Association and Key Control Protocol (ISAKMP) and Oakley Protocol. Those protocols paint together to establish a cozy tunnel and exchange keys for Encryption. The main advantage of using IKE is its ability to offer key management and authentication offerings for a couple of protection protocols, making it a surprisingly flexible and flexible solution for wireless community protection. One of the primary effectiveness of the IKE protocol lies in its potential to negotiate and set up at-ease connections among Wi-Fi gadgets, even within the presence of network address translation (NAT) gadgets. This feature suits it nicely for supplying protection in Wi-Fi networks where multiple gadgets might also have specific IP addresses. Moreover, the protocol supports diverse authentication strategies, digital certificates, and pre-shared keys, making it adaptable to exclusive security necessities. Moreover, the IKE protocol presents green essential trade through the usage of symmetric vital algorithms consisting of advanced Encryption widespread (AES)

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of Plant Seedlings: Distinguishing Crop Seedlings from Weed Seedlings Using MobileNetV2 Transfer Learning Model with Fine-Tuning Layers
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The presented research endeavours to address the notable challenge of distinguishing between crop seedlings and weed seedlings within the disciplines of agriculture and botany. Accurate classification of these categorizations is necessary in order to enhance agricultural practises and optimise crop output. To effectively tackle the issue, the adoption of a comprehensive approach was proposed that involves the use of the MobileNetV2 transfer learning model, together with the integration of fine-tuning layers. The study utilised an extensive dataset of 11,078 annotated images of plant seedlings, encompassing a diverse array of species. In order to enhance the robustness of the model and mitigate imbalances in class distribution, data augmentation techniques were implemented. The dataset was divided into three distinct categories, specifically the training, validation, and testing sets. The training process involved utilising a dataset consisting of 8973 photographs. Subsequently, the model's performance was evaluated by employing a separate set of 1108 images that had not been encountered during the training phase. The model utilised in this study was constructed based on the MobileNetV2 architecture, a well-known framework recognised for its exceptional performance and effectiveness in the field of picture categorization. In order to adapt to the specific attributes of the dataset, custom layers were integrated for the purpose of fine-tuning. In the phase of experimentation, a confusion matrix was utilised to evaluate the performance, resulting in a noteworthy accuracy rate of 97%. This result demonstrates the capacity of the model to effectively decrease the need for manual weed management and the dependence on chemical herbicides in the agricultural sector. Furthermore, our study provides a demonstration of the feasibility of employing deep learning and transfer learning techniques in comparable problems of plant species classification, hence presenting potential avenues for progress in the fields of agriculture and biology. In conclusion, our methodology has effectively showcased a precise approach in differentiating between crop and weed seedlings, therefore facilitating the adoption of sustainable agricultural practises and the protection of the environment.

articleTitle: An Industrial Wireless Sensors Networks for Securing Anonymous Mutual Authentication Protocol in Real-Time Data Access
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: When it comes to energy consumption, coverage, connection, and security, Industrial Wireless Sensor Networks (IWSNs) are a subset of WSNs that are only beginning to emerge. Since the nodes are linked to the internet as well as are often located in an unsupervised setting with few human interventions, privacy and security provide a significant challenge in IWSN. Having access to data in real time from predetermined sensor nodes is crucial for IWSN. This procedure necessitates the usage of a user authentication system. Lightweight, private, and mutual user authentication is proposed for IWSNs in this study so that only users with reliable devices are granted access. As a result, we took into account the sensor nodes' physical layer security in the suggested design. We demonstrate that the proposed system can preserve user anonymity even if an attacker obtains control of a sensor node. The proposed protocol uses primitive arithmetic operations (PUFs), XORs, with one-way crypto hash functions. The suggested technique is safe and effective, even with the constrained resources of IWSN sensors, as shown by the results of the security and efficiency analyses.

Leaf Scald's Recall value is 93.65%, demonstrating the model's success in identifying true positives. Sheath Blight's F1-Score of 92.52% exemplifies the study's model's all-around success. These results are supported by accuracy rates between 0.96 and 0.98, demonstrating the model's superiority in diagnosing diseases. Class support and proportion numbers are also emphasized for their importance in the study, as they provide crucial context to the investigation by measuring the number of examples in each class and their corresponding representation throughout the dataset. The study demonstrates the model's promise for actual disease management and yield optimization in rice farming, providing a trustworthy instrument for precisely categorizing various paddy leaf diseases. The model's impressive 92.194% accuracy indicates its prowess in categorizing a wide range of data.

abstract: This paper highlights the fabrication strategies to realize fabric-based microfluidic channels using wax which promise significant application in the next generation of wearable healthcare monitoring systems. The properties of cloth differ significantly from that of paper or any other surface, particularly in its pore size. Here a novel method has been employed to form the microfluidic channels with beeswax as the hydrophobic barriers over cotton fabric-based substrates with the optimization of various masking materials for the realization of the channels. Finally, a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu\text{FAD}$</tex> using PET clear sheet and beeswax over cotton fabric was successfully demonstrated for the realization of a rapid, low-cost diagnostic tool. articleTitle: The Wireless Sensor Networks with Overlapping Multihop Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Clustering is often utilised in wireless sensor networks to offer efficient and scalable operation. Typically, the goal of a clustering method is to produce a set of distinct groups that all meet a certain set of requirements. In this study, we introduce a new clustering problem with the goal of producing multi-hop clusters that overlap with one another. Inter-cluster routing, node location, and time synchronisation protocols are just a few examples of where overlapping clusters become valuable in sensor networks. We also present a multi-hop clustering method (MHC) that uses randomization and distributed computing to address the overlapping clustering issue. The goal of MHC is to produce linked overlapping clusters that, on average, overlap the whole sensor network. We analyse and simulate many scenarios to demonstrate how to optimise the clustering process's parameters. In addition, the findings demonstrate that MHC generates clusters of about similar sizes, which facilitates load distribution among clusters. In addition, despite the scope of the network, MHC's clustering creation ceases after a certain length of time.
