Specifically, it examines the advantages of computerized function engineering and the way system gaining knowledge of primarily based tools may be leveraged to offer businesses with actionable data insights extra efficaciously than conventional strategies. It additionally looks at a few rising technologies, inclusive of deep neural networks, and their capability to push the limits of information analysis in real-time, and also discusses how improvements in allotted computing can similarly supplement the impact of gadget studying gear. Eventually, this summary additionally affords some demanding situations associated with actual-time evaluation of massive volumes of facts, and some advised answers.

articleTitle: Unleashing Power Efficiency: A Study Comparing Pulsed Latches and Flip-Flops for Low-Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This study conducts a comparative analysis of different pulsed latches and flip-flops in a low VDD region. Flip-flops are essential components in electronic circuits and have a noteworthy effect on circuit performance. They play a crucial function in digital systems, therefore minimizing their power consumption can significantly lower system power consumption. The study presents a comparative study of five flip-flop designs: TGFF, ACFF, TCFF, SC2FF, and SAFF, alongside pulsed latches, TGPL, and STPL, which address high t-setup issues. The Cadence Virtuoso tool in 90nm CMOS technology is used to implement each design.

articleTitle: Application of Indoor Motion Measurement Technology based on SLAM Algorithm in Underground Engineering
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: SLAM technology is one of the important technologies in modern robot, automatic driving and other fields, which can carry out autonomous positioning and map building in unknown environment. In indoor motion measurement, SLAM algorithm also plays an important role, and its role and influence can be analyzed from the following aspects: Then, the visual sensor is used to measure the indoor movement of the underground project, form the indoor movement measurement scheme, and measure the indoor movement Conduct a comprehensive analysis. The formula estimation shows that under the condition of a certain measurement standard, the SLAM algorithm is a measurement technology for indoor movement of underground engineering The accuracy and the application time of indoor mobile measurement technology are better than the AMCL algorithm.

articleTitle: THD Analysis of Different Multilevel Inverter Topologies for PV Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Medium Voltage High Power (MVHP) applications have gained significant importance in today's industrial scenario. However, directly connecting Photovoltaic (PV) systems to MVHP systems can result in interconnection issues, which can be overcome by utilizing high-efficiency and low Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) inverters. This paper explores the application of versatile inverter topologies like Diode Clamed Multilevel Inverter (DCMLI), Flying Capacitor Multilevel Inverter (FCMLI), and Cascade H-bridge Multilevel Inverter (CHBMLI) for Grid Connected PV Applications, to enhance efficiency and reduce THD in the system. The Multi Carrier Pulse Width Modulation (MCPWM) technique is employed to control inverter switching. The paper analyzes the performance of 3, 5, and 7-level inverters. Among the three inverters, the CHBMLI is found to have less THD and fewer components for the same output level, making it a beneficial option for PV applications, particularly when operated with separate dc sources. The paper outlines the design and simulation of these inverters in the MATLAB/Simulink environment. The outcomes demonstrate that the CHBMLI topology is efficient in decreasing THD and enhancing efficiency in PV applications under steady-state conditions.

articleTitle: Assessing the Efficiency of AI for Multivariate Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This study aimed to evaluate the efficiency of synthetic Intelligence (AI) for multivariate records analysis. Multivariate statistics evaluation is a complicated venture that historically requires considerable manual labor and information in information science and machine mastering. AI can offer an extra green and accurate method to the venture. Consequently, this study employed a ramification of AI-based total methods to identify patterns and generate insights from the dataset. Traditional and ML algorithms were used to generate models based on the records. The models have been evaluated based on their metrics—accuracy, precision, and keep in mind. In the end, the effects from the models were analyzed to identify trends and institutions among the variables. The findings concluded that AI may want to provide a robust and accurate technique to perform multivariate records analysis. However, further research is needed to develop novel tactics to utilize AI for multivariate statistics evaluation with increased accuracy and precision.

articleTitle: Enhanced Red Chilli Disease Intensity Detection: A Novel Approach Integrating CNN and SVM for Precise Disease Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: A commonly grown crop, red chillies are susceptible to several illnesses, which significantly reduce yields and degrade product quality. To detect the intensity of red chilli sickness, this study suggests combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Support Vector Machines (SVMs). The model uses SVMs for precise categorization of disease intensity levels and CNNs for feature extraction from high-resolution photos of afflicted red chilli plants. To improve model generalisation, the dataset—which includes photos with varied degrees of disease severity—is augmented using data augmentation techniques. The model successfully detects disease intensity levels with good accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics, according to experimental results. By providing farmers with accurate and fast disease assessments for enhanced crop management and yield, the suggested methodology advances precision agriculture. To improve the performance of the model, future work may incorporate more optimisations, investigations into different CNN architectures, and kernel functions for SVM. Overall, the combined CNNSVM model shows significant promise for transforming crop management practises for sustainable and effective agriculture and revolutionising the detection of red chilli disease intensity

articleTitle: Enhancing the Quality of the Stego Image Using Quads-based Differences in Spatial Domain Images
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In contemporary times, ensuring the security of shared information is a paramount concern to prevent unauthorized interception during communication over public networks. One approach to address this challenge is implementing data hiding (DH) techniques. However, the concealment of confidential data within multimedia files, such as images, often results in a degradation of visual quality. This decline in quality can raise suspicions among unauthorized users regarding the potential presence of concealed data. Throughout the years, researchers have devised various DH algorithms to mitigate the issue of significant image distortion following the data embedding process. Nevertheless, achieving a high-quality stego image, which carries secret data, remains a formidable task. This paper introduces a novel DH method grounded in the difference expansion (DE) paradigm, aiming to enhance the quality of the stego image for a given payload size. Experimental results presented herein demonstrate an improvement in visual quality, albeit with the observation that augmenting the embedding capacity introduces additional noise.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of DWDM Network for Varying Link Length
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Dence Wavelength Division Multiplexing (DWDM) Optical fiber communication system performance is evaluated for varying link length and for different encoding formats. Bit Error Rate is observed at the channel spacing 1.6 nm and with data rate 10 Gbps. The BER values are better for smaller link lengths. The BER values at link length 10 Kms for 2, 4 and 8 channel systems are in the range of 10–<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</sup> which is better than threshold value 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup>. The BER values for Non Return to Zero (NRZ) modulation and Return to Zero (RZ) for link lengths 1,5,10 and 20 Kms is evaluated. In both the modulation formats the BER is better than threshold and also using NRZ the better values of BER is observed than RZ for 16 channel DWDM system.

articleTitle: Bridging Medical Terminology: Enhancing Accessibility and Comprehension
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Language barriers are a major problem in the healthcare industry because they restrict access to essential medical information, which prevents medical professionals from making well-informed decisions. The goal of this project is to create a solution that can overcome this barrier. This solution utilises a 3-step approach, combining a Medical Term Translation API, Text Summarizer, and Browser Extension. This integrated solution could enhance medical literacy and help make well-informed decisions in healthcare. This can help a large set of users to access and understand vital medical information and also enables them to become more involved in their healthcare and make informed choices about their treatment.

articleTitle: An Electronic Music Classification Model Based on Machine Learning Algorithm to Optimize Children's Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With the development of society, people pay more attention to children's brain development. Among them, electronic music is an important part of optimizing children's neural networks, so the classification of electronic music is particularly important, ordinary methods can not solve the problem of optimizing music in children's neural networks, and the classification is not accurate. Therefore, this paper proposes a machine learning algorithm to innovate and create accurate music analysis. First, artificial intelligence is used to analyze music content, and indicators are divided according to music requirements to reduce music in the interfering factor. The influence of electronic music on children's growth and education has gradually attracted attention. However, the research on electronic music classification based on children's neural network is rare. The purpose of this paper is to explore how to use machine learning algorithm to classify electronic music of children's neural network, so as to improve children's cognition and understanding of music.

articleTitle: Research on Several Calculation Methods for Lightning Protection and Grounding of Overhead Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With the increase of demand for power energy in social life, more and more overhead transmission lines have been built. In order to ensure the safety and stability of the transmission network, lightning protection and grounding design has always been the focus of power system research. According to statistical analysis, many of the faults on the transmission line are caused by lightning strikes, so the lightning protection design of the transmission line is a very important content. Therefore, this paper proposes a BP neural network algorithm to evaluate and analyze several calculation methods for lightning protection design and grounding. Lightning protection and grounding of overhead lines is a very important link in power system, which can effectively protect power equipment and personal safety. In this paper, several calculation methods for lightning protection grounding of overhead lines are compared, and their steps, functions and significance are discussed. line. The safety is superior to the classical method.

articleTitle: Indian Sign Language classification and Image Augmentation using GAN
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: A significant portion of the deaf and hard of hearing population in India communicates primarily through Indian Sign Language (ISL). Precise and successful recognition of ISL (International Sign Language) gestures can dramatically improve communication between people with hearing impairments and the rest of the community. This research introduces a novel method for identifying ISL motions that combines Convolutional Neural Networks, or CNN, with Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN). The study presents a unique method for classifying static hand positions representing letters in sign language using RGB photographs that employ a densely linked Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) design. The model employed a generative adversarial network (GAN) to balance the dataset to generate synthetic data that looked like actual data. With the help of GAN, the model has also augmented data since it was limited. Our proposed model demonstrates promising results in accurately detecting and classifying ISL gestures with an accuracy of 97.69 %, contributing to improved accessibility and inclusivity.

articleTitle: Investigating the Use of Neural Networks for AI-Based Image Recognition Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This paper examines the usage of synthetic intelligence (AI) to broaden photo recognition structures through neural networks. Strategies along with supervised gaining knowledge, unsupervised gaining knowledge, deep studying, and convolutional neural networks are investigated, as are their benefits and barriers. The paper appears at many demanding situations involved in neural networks for photo recognition, including the need for categorized information, the magnificence imbalance trouble, and the scalability issue. It additionally describes several methods to improve accuracy and velocity, combining different architectures and photograph pre-processing techniques. Eventually, the paper discusses the ability packages and future research directions of AI-based total image popularity structures.

articleTitle: E-Commerce User Purchase Prediction Based on Improved Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The role of consumer shopping demand in the operation forecast of e-commerce platforms is very important, but there is the problem of incomplete data estimation. The k-NN nearest neighbor algorithm cannot accurately predict the problem of user purchasing power in e-commerce platform data, and the sample is unbalanced, and the problem is handled in a single way. Therefore, this paper proposes a machine learning algorithm to analyze the shopping needs of e-commerce enterprises. Firstly, the Markov chain theory is used to evaluate the purchase behavior of users, and indicators are carried out according to the requirements of purchase historical data Divide and reduce distractions in purchasing behavior. Then, Markov chain theory evaluates the purchasing power of consumers, forms a consumer shopping demand program, and has a consumer shopping demand The results were comprehensively analyzed. MATLAB simulation shows that under certain evaluation criteria, the machine learning algorithm is accurate to the purchasing power of e-commerce platform users The range of consumer demand is better than the k-NN nearest neighbor algorithm.

articleTitle: Exploring the Synergy of Machine Learning and Blockchain in The Education Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The advent of blockchain and machine learning technologies has introduced revolutionary possibilities across various industries, and the education sector is no exception. Blockchain, as a decentralized and immutable distributed ledger, has the potential to transform the traditional education system by addressing some of its inherent challenges. This paper explores the application of blockchain and machine learning in the education system and its potential benefits

articleTitle: Research on English Teaching Quality Evaluation based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation based on K-Means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With the acceleration of globalization, English plays an increasingly important role in international communication. Therefore, the improvement of English teaching quality has become an important issue that educators pay attention to. In order to make a comprehensive, objective and scientific evaluation of English teaching, this study adopts K-means clustering fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, and analyzes the data of teachers, students and teaching environment, so as to provide targeted suggestions for improvement of English teaching

articleTitle: Improved Brain Tumor Classification Made Possible Through the Use of Transfer Learning Model ResNet50
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This study gives a detailed assessment of the performance of a classification model in the context of brain tumor classification, employing a dataset consisting of four separate classes: glioma tumors, meningioma tumors, normal brain tissue, and pituitary tumors. The results of this evaluation are presented in the form of a comparison. The model, which was constructed using transfer learning using the architecture of ResNet50, has been subjected to a stringent evaluation based on accuracy, recall, and F1-score for each class. The findings reveal high classification skills, with considerable accuracy, recall, and F1-Score value distributions across all classes, suggesting successful tumor type discrimination. The model's ability to accurately classify brain tumors is shown by the high overall accuracy score of 91%. In addition, macro and weighted averages provide additional evidence that the model's performance is well-balanced when taking into account class distribution. These discoveries contribute to the progress of medical image analysis, which promises more accurate and quick detection of brain cancers, leading to improvements in patient care.

articleTitle: Cloud-Based Design of Student Experiment System for University Laboratories
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With the rapid development of cloud computing technology, more and more applications are migrating to the cloud. In the field of education, it has become a trend to use cloud computing technology to improve teaching efficiency and resource utilization. Cloud-based experimental system for college laboratory students can not only provide students with a convenient experimental environment, but also help teachers better manage experimental resources and improve teaching quality. This paper will introduce in detail the design of college laboratory student experiment system based on cloud

articleTitle: Research on Traffic Classification Algorithm of Power Communication Network based on Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Power communication network is an important infrastructure in power system, and its security and stability are very important to ensure the normal operation of power system. With the development and application of power system, the traffic of power communication network is increasing, and the classification of traffic is of great significance for network management and optimization. In this paper, a classification algorithm based on clustering analysis is proposed to solve the problem of traffic classification in power communication network. The algorithm can effectively classify the traffic data and provide powerful support for the management and optimization of power communication network

articleTitle: Long-Short Term Memory Analysis of EEG Data Using Python for Emotion Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Python has made significant progress and its adaptability allows it to be utilized in nearly all fields recognized by humanity. The utilization of this technology in the field of research and development has left a distinctive impact. Advancements in brain research have occurred at a rapid pace, resulting in a continuous stream of novel results being unveiled on a daily basis. Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals refer to the electrical impulses generated by the brain in reaction to specific visual stimuli, such as positive, negative, neutral, or soothing stimuli. The utilization of Python, along with its robust modules and libraries, facilitates the efficient identification and subsequent study of human emotions, hence enabling emotion recognition. In this discussion, we will explore Long Short Term memory a machine learning (ML) models that demonstrate efficacy in extracting and conveying significant insights pertaining to the human brain and EEG signals.

articleTitle: Prediction of Diabetes Using Machine Learning Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Diabetes is the most prevalent chronic disease and a number of people are suffering from it all over the world. Diabetes could be due to hereditary reasons, obesity, etc. Diabetes can cause other complications like heart disease, so prediction and prevention of diabetes is of utmost importance. In this paper, five machine learning algorithms that are Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Support Vector Machine and K-Nearest Neighbor have been used for the prediction of diabetes. It was found that Logistic Regression performed the best amongst the five classifiers and obtained highest accuracy of 0.7359, precision of 0.7312, recall of 0.7359 and f1-score of 0.7329.

articleTitle: Guaranteed Data Recovery and Oscillatory Mode Estimation in Power System Using Novel RPCA
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Presence of malicious injection occurs as the consequence of cyberattacks or PMU malfunctioning due to which the signals obtained from PMUs may have an impact on the stability & functionality of the power networks. A technique for detecting phony data in PMU measurements is presented in this paper. A robust Principal Component Analysis (RPCA) with Probabilistic Distributional Clustering (PDC) based technique is used to recover the malicious signals in the compressed sensing problem formulation for bad data detection. Lastly, Esprit based method is utilized for mode estimation. By doing a statistical analysis research on a synthetic signal using Monte Carlo simulation, the efficacy & resilience of the Novel Robust PCA technique are confirmed and contrasted with other recently discovered methods. Additionally, real probing data and two area data from the Western Electricity Co-ordinating Council (WECC) are used to validate this technique.

articleTitle: Speed Violation Detection and Enforcement with CNN and IoT Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Worldwide traffic accidents and deaths are largely attributable to drivers going too fast for conditions. This research introduces a unique method for detecting and enforcing speeding violations using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and the Internet of Things (IoT). The system employs deep learning and collects data in real-time from IoT devices. In this case, it describes developing a CNN–based method for analyzing traffic camera footage in real-time. The CNN model reliably detects moving objects and estimates their velocity. Accurate vehicle tracking is achieved by integrating data from IoT sensors, such as global positioning and vehicle identification systems. Cloud computing allows for the transfer and processing of data in near real-time. It shows that this combined method may successfully identify speeding violations. The IoT data verified the results, indicating that the CNN model had an accuracy of over 90% in speed estimation, which allowed for automated enforcement measures. Enforcement response times can also be drastically reduced by including real-time monitoring and alerting. The system provides a viable approach for speed violation identification and enforcement by merging CNN image processing with IoT data, leading to safer road environments and fewer accidents. It predicts this technique will significantly improve road safety on a global scale, which will, in turn, revolutionize traffic management.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Scan Chain in Subthreshold Region
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Testing of manufactured Integrated Circuit (IC) is performed using design for testability (DFT) techniques such as scan chain which is most popular in sequential circuits. The scan cell involves the modification of a D flip-flop (DFF) with a multiplexer at its input. During testing, a pattern is applied through the scan input pin (SI) in which individual flip-flops toggle their values as the test patterns are shifted in hence a significant amount of power is consumed in scan chain. Although moving to a lower technology node decreases the power consumption in a circuit, a further drastic reduction (i.e. 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> order) in power consumption is obtained by operating the circuit in the subthreshold region. In this work scan chain is designed to operate correctly in the subthreshold region using suitable device sizes, using both transmission gate (TG) based and true single phase clocked (TSPC) logic for 16, 22 & 32 nm technology nodes. Further, their average powers are compared. In addition, the Monte Carlo simulation and comparative analysis are performed to study the effect of variation of power supply and temperature.

articleTitle: Investigating the Effectiveness of Birthday Attack Strategies in Cryptography Network Security
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Cryptography is a crucial factor of community safety because it involves growing and decoding mystery codes to guard touchy statistics from unauthorized right of entry. As the era advances, community protection professionals must continuously evaluate the effectiveness of numerous cryptographic techniques and techniques. One such method is the birthday attack, a form of brute-pressure attack that takes benefit of the birthday paradox – the chance that in a group of people, two people will proportion an equal birthday. In cryptography, this attack is used to discover collisions in a hashing function, wherein different enter messages produce identical output. This have a look at examines the effectiveness of various birthday attack strategies in a cryptography community protection context. specially, the studies observes the numerous algorithms and scenarios concerning the use of birthday attack methods and how they're being utilized in network safety structures. moreover, the have a look at strives to apprehend how the boom within the sophistication of the cryptography networks has brought about an boom in the prevalence and effectiveness of the birthday attack. The research seeks to cope with the diverse problems and challenges faced by using cryptography networks using the birthday attack approach, inclusive of reducing the reliability of certain factors of the cryptography network and exposing the ability of introducing vulnerabilities into the device. The examine additionally examines the usage of multi-layered birthday attack strategies, which include utilising a couple of algorithms and using a mixture of various methods, as well as exploring the capacity of any new threat vectors which may be used. in the end, the studies will explore whether or not there are any first-rate practices or methods which may be used to lessen the chance associated with any a hit birthday assault tries. The consequences of this take a look at could be used to gain a deeper knowledge of the related risks in addition to informing destiny efforts to reinforce and enhance the safety protocols followed in cryptography networks.

articleTitle: Examining and Evaluating Comparator Circuit Performance Experimentally at Various Technology Nodes
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In the realm of analog circuit design, the study of low-power, high-precision, and high-speed, comparator circuits holds paramount significance. Dynamic comparators, recognized as pivotal elements in the construction of ADC's and sense amplifiers, play a crucial role in achieving optimal precision, minimal offset voltage, low power consumption, faster operation, less power consumption, and greater dependability. However, no single circuit can comprehensively offer all these desirable attributes. This research paper delves into the analysis of propagation delays, power dissipation, energy, offset voltage, and noise. Through this study, readers can derive analytical expressions to comparator performance. To validate the findings, extensive simulations were conducted using cadence virtuoso in 180nm, 90nm, and 45nm CMOS technology nodes.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Reliable Converter Topology for Grid Connected PV Systems with ANN Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This research paper introduces a comprehensive analysis and design of a dependable converter topology specifically designed for grid-connected photovoltaic (PV) systems. The main objective of this study is to optimize power output and enhance the reliability of the system by presenting a modified version of the cascaded H-bridge inverter (CHB) that incorporates an artificial neural network (ANN) controller. The performance of the proposed topology is compared against two commonly used converter topologies, namely the two-level inverter and the neutral point clamped (NPC) inverter. Through extensive simulations, it is evident that the proposed topology, along with the ANN controller, yields notable improvements in power quality, efficiency, and reliability when compared to the alternative topologies. It demonstrates exceptional capability in handling grid disturbances and maintaining a stable power output even under varying operating conditions. The integration of the ANN controller empowers the converter topology to acquire learning abilities and adaptability to ensure stable and reliable operation despite changes in solar power inputs and atmospheric conditions. The outcomes of this research contribute significantly to the progress of PV system integration into the grid, offering a promising solution for grid-connected PV systems. The proposed topology, accompanied by the ANN controller, exhibits superior performance and reliability, rendering it suitable for a wide range of operating conditions. The study underscores the significance of developing converter topologies capable of effectively managing fluctuations in PV system output and ensuring consistent power supply quality, thereby facilitating the successful integration of renewable energy sources into the grid.

articleTitle: Novel Practices in Software Documentation for Continuous Delivery and Integration Using Feature Toggles
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In the field of software development, the practice of incremental feature delivery facilitates the implementation of continuous software delivery cycles characterized by a significant degree of flexibility and agility. The acceleration of software documentation distribution for these features can be facilitated through the utilization of feature toggles. In the context of the continuous delivery paradigm, technical writers frequently encounter the challenge of reverting the content associated with a particular feature if it is deemed unsuitable for deployment. The manual technique of rolling back has a propensity for errors and carries a significant likelihood of inadvertently disclosing feature documentation for features that have not been implemented. The primary aim of this work is to examine an implementation technique that facilitates the seamless integration between the feature repository and the documentation tool. This integration addresses two difficulties encountered by technical writers. The visibility of documentation is determined by the status of the feature in the feature repository, hence eliminating the need for manual roll-back. Furthermore, this feature aids technical writers in maintaining consistency inside their writing between present and forthcoming versions. The suggested implementation approach offers a means of communication between the feature repository and the documentation system through the utilization of an Application Programming Interface (API). The documentation delivery procedure for incremental feature delivery is streamlined by utilizing the feature repository as the authoritative source.

articleTitle: Safeguarding Web Environments Through Supervised Learning-Based Cross-Site Scripting Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks have emerged as an important issue in the Internet of Things(IoT) ecosystem as a result of the expansion of IoT devices. The use of machine learning(ML) methods to predict XSS threats in IoT systems is examined in this paper. Several ML approaches for XSS detection in IoT including Naive Bayes(NB), Logistics Regression(LR), Decision Tree(DT) and Adaptive Gradient Boosting(AdaBoost) approaches have been compared that make use of a customised feature set that includes device conversations, communication patterns, and packet characteristics. The framework shows its effectiveness in accurately detecting XSS assaults through the use of supervised learning techniques. The effectiveness of the framework in a variety of device kinds and attack situations has been validated by extensive testing utilising various IoT datasets. Additionally, it looks into the model's accessibility, illuminating the warning signs of XSS attacks particular to the IoT environment. The research fills a crucial role in the protection of linked devices from more sophisticated cyber threats, making a contribution to the emerging subject of IoT security. The research provides a foundation for creating resilient defence systems that utilise the power of ML to protect IoT ecosystems against XSS vulnerabilities as the IoT environment continues to develop. The paper predicts XSS attacks that used various ML approaches, including NB, LR, DT, and AdaBoost, using the XSS attack detection dataset. Accuracy, sensitivity, precision, specificity and F1-score performance criteria have been used to identify the best ML model. The AdaBoost model, with an accuracy rating of 99.92%, is the most accurate, preceded by the NB, LR, and DT models, with accuracy ratings of 88.89%, 99.85% and 99.89%, respectively.

articleTitle: A Pre-Trained VGG16 Model for Cataract Eye Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: A cataract is a common eye condition that predominantly affects the eye's crystalline lens, resulting in a diminishing of its natural transparency and a gradual decline in visual sharpness. This clouding of the lens can hinder the capacity to perceive objects clearly and difficulty in carry out everyday tasks effortlessly. Early and precise diagnosis of this disease plays a crucial role for securing vision quality and avoiding life-threatening issues. This paper proposes a novel method for detecting cataract disease at early stages using a convolutional neural network-based VGG16 model. This technique has achieved a remarkable accuracy of 96.10% on the cataract and normal eye disease dataset collected from Kaggle. This model has been fine-tuned by keeping the value of the learning rate at 0.01 and the accuracy has been measured at epochs 5, 10, 15, and 20. The loss value of the proposed odel has been also measured which identified that the model shows the least loss of 0.1651 at epoch 20. This study also highlights the potential of deep learning to revolutionize the detection of eye diseases while simultaneously highlighting the significance of moral and cooperative approaches to the quest for better healthcare solutions.
